83.ar: الصّادق (- عَنْ أَبِی بَصِیرٍ عَنْ أَبِی عَبْدِ اللَّهِ (قَالَ: سَأَلْتُهُ عَنْ قَوْلِ اللَّهِ: یَسْئَلُونَکَ عَنْ ذِی الْقَرْنَیْنِ قُلْ سَأَتْلُوا عَلَیْکُمْ مِنْهُ ذِکْراً قَالَ إِنَّ ذَا الْقَرْنَیْنِ بَعَثَهُ اللَّهُ إِلَی قَوْمِهِ فَضَرَبُوهُ عَلَی قَرْنِهِ الْأَیْمَنِ فَأَمَاتَهُ اللَّهُ خَمْسَمِائَةِ عَامٍ ثُمَّ بَعَثَهُ إِلَیْهِمْ بَعْدَ ذَلِکَ فَضَرَبُوهُ عَلَی قَرْنِهِ الْأَیْسَرِ فَأَمَاتَهُ اللَّهُ خَمْسَمِائَةِ عَامٍ ثُمَّ بَعَثَهُ إِلَیْهِمْ بَعْدَ ذَلِکَ فَمَلَّکَهُ مَشَارِقَ الْأَرْضِ وَ مَغَارِبَهَا مِنْ حَیْثُ تَطْلُعُ الشَّمْسُ إِلَی حَیْثُ تَغْرُبُ فَهُوَ قَوْلُهُ حَتَّی إِذا بَلَغَ مَغْرِبَ الشَّمْسِ وَجَدَها تَغْرُبُ فِی عَیْنٍ حَمِئَةٍ إِلَی قَوْلِهِ عَذاباً نُکْراً قَالَ فِی النَّارِ فَجَعَلَ ذُو الْقَرْنَیْنِ بَیْنَهُمْ بَاباً مِنْ نُحَاسٍ وَ حَدِیدٍ وَ زِفْتٍ وَ قَطِرَانٍ فَحَالَ بَیْنَهُمْ وَ بَیْنَ الْخُرُوجِ ثُمَّ قَالَ أَبُو عَبْدِ اللَّهِ (: لَیْسَ مِنْهُمْ رَجُلٌ یَمُوتُ حَتَّی یُولَدَ لَهُ مِنْ صُلْبِهِ أَلْفُ وَلَدٍ ذَکَرٍ ثُمَّ قَالَ هُمْ أَکْثَرُ خَلْقٍ خُلِقُوا بَعْدَ الْمَلَائِکَة.
83.en: Abu Basir said: I asked Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) about the saying of Allah: "They ask you about Dhu al-Qarnayn. Say: 'I will recite to you a remembrance of him.'" The Imam (peace be upon him) said: "Allah sent Dhu al-Qarnayn to his people, and they struck him on the right side of his forehead. So Allah caused him to die for five hundred years, then He resurrected him to them after that. They struck him on the left side of his forehead, so Allah caused him to die for five hundred years, then He resurrected him to them after that and gave him dominion over the east and west of the earth, from where the sun rises to where it sets. This is the meaning of the saying of Allah: 'Until, when he reached the setting of the sun, he found it [as if] setting in a spring of dark mud,' up to His saying: '...and will punish him with a severe punishment.' He (the Imam) said: 'In the Fire.' So Dhu al-Qarnayn made a gate between them and [the outside] of copper, iron, pitch, and tar, and he prevented them from coming out." Then Abu Abd Allah (peace be upon him) said: "Not one man among them dies until a thousand male children are born from his loins." Then he said: "They are the most numerous of the creatures created after the angels."
83.book: Tafsir Ahl al-Bayt (peace be upon them), Vol. 8, p. 598

83.ar: امیرالمؤمنین (- عَنْ سِمَاکِ بْنِ حَرْبِ بْنِ حَبِیبٍ قَالَ: أَتَی رَجُلٌ عَلِیّاً (فَقَالَ یَا أمِیرُالمُؤمِنین (أَخْبِرْنِی عَنْ ذِی الْقَرْنَیْنِ فَقَالَ لَهُ عَلِیٌّ (سُخِّرَتْ لَهُ السَّحَابُ وَ قَرُبَتْ لَهُ الْأَسْبَابُ وَ بُسِطَ لَهُ فِی النُّورِ فَقال (کَانَ یُبْصِرُ بِاللَّیْلِ کَمَا یُبْصِرُ بِالنَّهَار.ِ
83.fa: مردی به نزد امام علی (علیه السلام) آمد و به ایشان فرمود: «ای امیرمؤمنان (علیه السلام)! از ذوالقرنین با من بگو». حضرت به او فرمود: «ابرها مسخر او گردید و اسباب برایش فراهم شد و نور و روشنایی برایش گسترانیده شد». مرد از او پرسید: «معنای بسط نور چیست»؟ امام (علیه السلام) پاسخ داد: «شب برای او همچون روز روشن بود».
83.en: Simak ibn Harb ibn Habib said: A man came to Ali and said, "O Commander of the Faithful, tell me about Dhu al-Qarnayn." Ali said to him, "The clouds were subjected to him, the means were made accessible to him, and light was spread out for him." He asked, "What is the meaning of light being spread out for him?" He replied, "He could see at night just as he could see during the day."
83.book: Tafsir Ahl al-Bayt (as), Vol. 8, p. 600

83.ar: علی بن ابراهیم (- فَلَمَّا أَخْبَرَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ (بِخَبَرِ مُوسَی وَ فَتَاهُ وَ الخِضْر قَالُوا فَأَخْبِرْنَا عَنْ طَائِفٍ- طَافَ الْمَشْرِقَ وَ الْمَغْرِبَ مَنْ هُوَ وَ مَا قِصَّتُهُ فَأَنْزَلَ اللَّهُ وَ یَسْئَلُونَکَ عَنْ ذِی الْقَرْنَیْنِ قُلْ سَأَتْلُوا عَلَیْکُمْ مِنْهُ ذِکْراً إِنَّا مَکَّنَّا لَهُ فِی الْأَرْضِ وَ آتَیْناهُ مِنْ کُلِّ شَیْءٍ سَبَباً.
83.fa: هنگامی‌که پیامبر اکرم (صلی الله علیه و آله) اخبار موسی و یوشع‌بن‌نون و خضر (را میگفت، از او پرسیدند: «آن کس که مشرق و مغرب را گشت چه کسی بود و داستانش چیست»؟ و دراین‌هنگام بود که خداوند این آیه را نازل کرد: وَ یَسْئَلُونَکَ عَنْ ذِی الْقَرْنَیْنِ قُلْ سَأَتْلُوا عَلَیْکُمْ مِنْهُ ذِکْراً إِنَّا مَکَّنَّا لَهُ فِی الْأَرْضِ وَ آتَیْناهُ مِنْ کُلِّ شَیْءٍ سَبَباً.
83.en: When the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) related the accounts of Moses, his young companion, and al-Khidr, they said, "Tell us about the one who traveled the East and the West; who was he and what is his story?" It was then that Allah revealed: "And they ask you about Dhu al-Qarnayn. Say, 'I will recite to you a remembrance of him. Indeed, We established him upon the earth, and We gave him from everything a way.'"
83.book: Tafsir Ahl al-Bayt (peace be upon them), Vol. 8, p. 600

83.ar: الصّادق (- وَ یَسْئَلُونَکَ عَنْ ذِی الْقَرْنَیْنِ فِی بَیَانِ عَمَلِ السَّدِّ عَنْ أَبِی عَبْدِاللَّهِ (قَالَ فَحَالَ بَیْنَ یَأْجُوجَ وَمَأْجُوجَ وَ بَیْنَ الْخُرُوجِ.
83.fa: وَ یَسْئَلُونَکَ عَنْ ذِی الْقَرْنَیْنِ، درباره‌ی بیان‌ساختن سدّ از امام صادق (علیه السلام) [روایت است] که فرمود: «[ذوالقرنین با ساختن سدّ] بین یأجوج و مأجوج و بین خروج [آن‌ها] حائل شد».
83.en: Regarding the verse "And they ask you about Dhu al-Qarnayn," concerning the explanation of the construction of the barrier, Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) said: "[Dhu al-Qarnayn, by building the barrier,] placed a partition between Gog and Magog and their emergence."
83.book: Tafsir Ahl al-Bayt (peace be upon them), Vol. 8, p. 600

85.ar: علی بن ابراهیم (- وَ الدَّلِیلُ عَلَی أَنَّ السَّبَبَ هُوَ الدَّلِیلُ قَوْلُ اللَّهِ فِی سُورَةَ الْکَهْفِ وَ آتَیْناهُ مِنْ کُلِّ شَیْءٍ سَبَباً فَأَتْبَعَ سَبَباً أَیْ دَلِیلًا.
85.fa: علّت اینکه سبب را دلیل معنی کردیم این است که خداوند در سوره‌ی کهف می‌فرماید: وَ آتَیْناهُ مِنْ کُلِّ شَیْءٍ سَبَباً یعنی دلیل.
85.en: The reason we interpreted "sabab" (cause/means) as "dalil" (guide/proof) is that God says in Surah Al-Kahf: "And We gave him a way (sabab) to everything," meaning a guide (dalil).
85.book: Tafsir Ahl al-Bayt (peace be upon them), Vol. 8, p. 600
85.refs: Bihar al-Anwar, Vol. 9, p. 224; Al-Qummi, Vol. 2, p. 79

85.ar: امیرالمؤمنین (- فَسَارَ ذُوالْقَرْنَیْنِ إِلَی نَاحِیَةِ الْمَغْرِبِ فَکَانَ إِذَا مَرَّ بِقَرْیَةٍ زَأَرَ فِیهَا کَمَا یَزْأَرُ الْأَسَدُ الْمُغْضَبُ فَیُبْعَثُ مِنْ قَرْنَیْهِ ظُلُمَاتٌ وَ رَعْدٌ وَ بَرْقٌ وَ صَوَاعِقُ تُهْلِکُ مَنْ نَاوَاهُ وَ خَالَفَهُ فَلَمْ یَبْلُغْ مَغْرِبَ الشَّمْسِ حَتَّی دَانَ لَهُ أَهْلُ الْمَشْرِقِ وَ الْمَغْرِبِ قَالَ وَ ذَلِکَ قَوْلُ اللَّهِ إِنَّا مَکَّنَّا لَهُ فِی الْأَرْضِ وَ آتَیْناهُ مِنْ کُلِّ شَیْءٍ سَبَباً.
85.fa: آنگاه ذوالقرنین به‌سمت غرب رفت و هرگاه بر قریه‌ای عبور می‌کرد، نعره‌ای همچون شیر خشمگین می‌کشید و از دو شاخ روی سرش، تاریکی و رعد و برق و صاعقه درخشیدن می‌گرفت که همه‌ی مخالفانش را هلاک می‌کرد. شرق و غرب عالم مطیع او شدند و خداوند دراین‌باره میفرماید: إِنَّا مَکَّنَّا لَهُ فِی الْأَرْضِ وَ آتَیْناهُ مِنْ کُلِّ شَیْءٍ سَبَباً.
85.en: Then Dhul-Qarnayn traveled toward the direction of the west. Whenever he passed by a village, he would roar in it like an enraged lion, and from his two horns would emanate darkness, thunder, lightning, and thunderbolts that would destroy whoever opposed him and defied him. He did not reach the setting place of the sun until the people of the east and the west had submitted to him. He said: And that is the saying of Allah, "Indeed We established him upon the earth, and We gave him from everything a way."
85.book: Tafsir Ahl al-Bayt (peace be upon them), Vol. 8, p. 600
85.refs: Bihar al-Anwar, Vol. 12, p. 198; Al-Ayyashi, Vol. 2, p. 341

85.ar: الصّادق (- فَسَارَ ذُو الْقَرْنَیْنِ إِلَی نَاحِیَةِ الْمَغْرِبِ فَکَانَ إِذَا مَرَّ بِقَرْیَةٍ زَأَرَ فِیهَا کَمَا یَزْأَرُ الْأَسَدُ الْمُغْضَبُ، فَیَنْبَعِثُ فِی الْقَرْیَةِ ظُلُمَاتٌ وَ رَعْدٌ وَ بَرْقٌ- وَ صَوَاعِقُ تُهْلِکُ مَنْ نَاوَاهُ وَ خَالَفَهُ، فَلَمْ یَبْلُغْ مَغْرِبَ الشَّمْسِ حَتَّی دَانَ لَهُ أَهْلُ الْمَشْرِقِ وَ الْمَغْرِبِ، فَقَالَ أَمِیرُ الْمُؤْمِنِینَ (وَ ذَلِکَ قَوْلُهُ عَزَّ وَ جَلَّ: إِنَّا مَکَّنَّا لَهُ فِی الْأَرْضِ وَ آتَیْناهُ مِنْ کُلِّ شَیْءٍ سَبَباً أَیْ دَلِیلا.
85.fa: ذوالقرنین به مغرب رفت در راه خود به روستایی رسید و مانند شیر غضبناک غرّش کرد و از غرّش او تاریکی و رعد و برق و صاعقه‌هایی پدید آمد که مخالفان و دشمنانش را نابود میکرد و همین‌که به مغرب خورشید رسید، تمامی مردم زمین تحت سلطه‌ی او در آمدند که در این آیه به این موضوع اشاره شده است: إِنَّا مَکَّنَّا لَهُ فِی الْأَرْضِ وَ آتَیْناهُ مِنْ کُلِّ شَیْءٍ سَبَباً یعنی نشانهای.
85.en: Dhu al-Qarnayn traveled toward the direction of the west. Whenever he passed by a village, he would roar in it like an enraged lion. Consequently, darkness, thunder, lightning, and thunderbolts would erupt in the village, destroying those who opposed him and defied him. He did not reach the setting place of the sun until the people of the east and the west had submitted to him. The Commander of the Faithful (as) said: "And that is the saying of the Almighty and Exalted: 'Indeed We established him upon the earth, and We gave him from everything a way'—meaning a guide."

86.ar: الصّادق (- فَمَلَّکَهُ مَشَارِقَ الْأَرْضِ وَ مَغَارِبَهَا مِنْ حَیْثُ تَطْلُعُ الشَّمْسُ إِلَی حَیْثُ تَغْرُبُ فَهُوَ قَوْلُهُ حَتَّی إِذا بَلَغَ مَغْرِبَ الشَّمْسِ وَجَدَها تَغْرُبُ فِی عَیْنٍ حَمِئَة.
86.fa: مغرب و مشرق زمین را تحت تصرّف او در آورد؛ از آنجا که خورشید طلوع میکند تا آنجا که غروب میکند. این است معنای این سخن خداوند که فرمود: حَتَّی إِذا بَلَغَ مَغْرِبَ الشَّمْسِ وَجَدَها تَغْرُبُ فِی عَیْنٍ حَمِئَةٍ.
86.en: He gave him dominion over the easts and wests of the earth, from where the sun rises to where it sets. This is the meaning of the words of God, the Exalted: "Until, when he reached the setting of the sun, he found it setting in a spring of murky water."
86.book: Tafsir Ahl al-Bayt (peace be upon them), Vol. 8, p. 602

86.ar: امیرالمؤمنین (- سُئِلَ أمِیرُِالمُؤمِنین (عَنْ ذِی الْقَرْنَیْنِ أَ نَبِیّاً (کَانَ أَمْ مَلِکاً (فَقَالَ لَا نبیا وَ لَا مَلِکاً بَلْ عَبْداً أَحَبَّ اللَّهَ فَأَحَبَّهُ وَ نَصَحَ لِلَّهِ فَنَصَحَ لَهُ فَبَعَثَهُ إِلَی قَوْمِهِ فَضَرَبُوهُ عَلَی قَرْنِهِ الْأَیْمَنِ فَغَابَ عَنْهُمْ مَا شَاءَ اللَّهُ أَنْ یَغِیبَ ثُمَّ بَعَثَهُ الثَّانِیَةَ فَضَرَبُوهُ عَلَی قَرْنِهِ الْأَیْسَرِ فَغَابَ عَنْهُمْ مَا شَاءَ اللَّهُ أَنْ یَغِیبَ ثُمَّ بَعَثَهُ اللَّهُ الثَّالِثَةَ فَمَکَّنَ اللَّهُ لَهُ فِی الْأَرْضِ وَ فِیکُمْ مِثْلُهُ یَعْنِی نَفْسَهُ {فَ} بَلَغَ مَغْرِبَ الشَّمْسِ فَوَجَدَها تَغْرُبُ فِی عَیْنٍ حَمِئَةٍ وَ وَجَدَ عِنْدَها قَوْماً قُلْنا یا ذَا الْقَرْنَیْنِ إِمَّا أَنْ تُعَذِّبَ وَ إِمَّا أَنْ تَتَّخِذَ فِیهِمْ حُسْنا.
86.fa: برخی از امام علی (علیه السلام) پرسیدند: «ذوالقرنین پیامبر بود یا پادشاه»؟ حضرت پاسخ داد: «او نه پیامبر بود و نه پادشاه، بلکه بنده ای بود که دوستدار خداوند شد و خداوند نیز او را دوست داشت و برای او خیرخواه بود و خداوند نیز برای او خیرخواه بود. خداوند، او را به سوی قومش فرستاد. آنان بر شاخ راست او زدند و او تا زمانی که خداوند خواست، از دیدگانشان پنهان گشت. پس خداوند، او را دوباره فرستاد. آنان این بار بر شاخ چپ او زدند و او تا زمانی که خداوند خواست، از دیدگانشان پنهان شد.. سپس خداوند، او را برای بار سوم فرستاد و در زمین مکنت بخشید. در میان شما نیز کسی مانند او هست. - مقصود حضرت، خودش بود - او به غروب گاه خورشید رسید و آن را طوری یافت که انگار خورشید در چشمه تیره و گل‌آلودی فرو می‌رود؛ و در آن جا قومی را یافت؛ گفتیم: «ای ذو القرنین! آیا می‌خواهی [آنان] را مجازات کنی، و یا روش نیکویی در مورد آنها انتخاب نمایی»؟
86.en: Amir al-Mu'minin (peace be upon him) was asked about Dhu al-Qarnayn: "Was he a prophet or a king?" He replied: "He was neither a prophet nor a king, but a servant who loved God, so God loved him; he was sincere to God, so God was sincere to him. God sent him to his people, but they struck him on his right horn, and he disappeared from them for as long as God willed. Then God sent him a second time, and they struck him on his left horn, and he disappeared from them for as long as God willed. Then God sent him a third time, and God established his power on earth. And among you is one like him"—meaning himself—"He reached the setting place of the sun and found it setting in a muddy spring, and he found a people near it. We said: 'O Dhu al-Qarnayn, either you punish [them] or you adopt a good way toward them.'"
86.book: Tafsir Ahl al-Bayt (peace be upon them), Vol. 8, p. 602

86.ar: العسکری (- وَ سُئِلَ عَلِیٌّ (عَنْ ذِی الْقَرْنَیْنِ: کَیْفَ اسْتَطَاعَ أَنْ یَبْلُغَ الْمَشْرِقَ وَ الْمَغْرِبَ؟ فَقَالَ: سَخَّرَ اللَّهُ السَّحَابَ وَ یَسَّرَ لَهُ الْأَسْبَابَ وَ بَسَطَ لَهُ النُّورَ وَ کَانَ اللَّیْلُ وَ النَّهَارُ عَلَی سَوَاءٍ، وَ أَنَّهُ رَأَی فِی الْمَنَامِ کَأَنَّهُ دَنَا مِنَ الشَّمْسِ حَتَّی أَخَذَ بِقَرْنِهَا فِی شَرْقِهَا وَ غَرْبِهَا فَلَمَّا قَصَّ رُؤْیَاهُ عَلَی قَوْمِهِ عَرَفَهُمْ وَ سَمَّوْهُ ذَا الْقَرْنَیْنِ فَدَعَاهُمْ إِلَی اللَّهِ فَأَسْلَمُوا ثُمَّ أَمَرَهُمْ أَنْ یَبْنُوا لَهُ مَسْجِداً فَأَجَابُوهُ إِلَیْهِ فَأَمَرَ أَنْ یَجْعَلُوا طُولَهُ أَرْبَعَمِائَةِ ذِرَاعٍ وَ عَرْضَهُ مِائَتَیْ ذِرَاعٍ وَ عُلُوَّهُ إِلَی السَّمَاءِ مِائَةَ ذِرَاعٍ فَقَالُوا: کَیْفَ لَکَ بِخَشَبَاتٍ تَبْلُغُ مَا بَیْنَ الْحَائِطَیْنِ؟ قَالَ: إِذَا فَرَغْتُمْ مِنْ بُنْیَانِ الْحَائِطَیْنِ فَاکْبِسُوهُ بِالتُّرَابِ حَتَّی یَسْتَوِیَ مَعَ حِیطَانِ الْمَسْجِدِ فَإِذَا فَرَغْتُمْ مِنْ ذَلِکَ أَخَذْتُمْ مِنَ الذَّهَبِ وَ الْفِضَّةِ عَلَی قَدْرِهِ ثُمَّ قَطَعْتُمُوهُ مِثْلَ قُلَامَةِ الظُّفُرِ ثُمَّ خَلَطْتُمُوهُ مَعَ ذَلِکَ الْکَبْسِ وَ عَمِلْتُمْ لَهُ خَشَباً مِنْ نُحَاسٍ وَ صَفَائِحَ مِنْ نُحَاسٍ تَذُوبُونَ ذَلِکَ وَ أَنْتُمْ مُتَمَکِّنُونَ مِنَ الْعَمَلِ کَیْفَ شِئْتُمْ وَ أَنْتُمْ عَلَی أَرْضٍ مُسْتَوِیَةٍ فَإِذَا فَرَغْتُمْ مِنْ ذَلِکَ دَعَوْتُمُ الْمَسَاکِینَ لِنَقْلِ ذَلِکَ التُّرَابِ فَیُسَارِعُونَ فِیهِ مِنْ أَجْلِ مَا فِیهِ مِنَ الذَّهَبِ وَ الْفِضَّةِ فَبَنَوُا الْمَسْجِدَ وَ أَخْرَجَ الْمَسَاکِینُ ذَلِکَ التُّرَابَ وَ قَدِ اسْتَقَلَّ السَّقْفُ وَ اسْتَغْنَی الْمَسَاکِینُ فَجَنَّدَهُمْ أَرْبَعَةَ أَجْنَادٍ فِی کُلِّ جُنْدٍ عَشْرَةُ آلَافٍ وَ نَشَرَهُمْ فِی الْبِلادِ.
86.fa: از امیرالمؤمنین علی (علیه السلام) درباره‌ی «ذوالقرنین» سؤال شد: «چگونه می‌توانست به مشرق و مغرب برسد»؟ فرمود: «ابر در تسخیر او بود و اسباب و وسایل برای او فراهم و نور برای او گسترانیده شده و شب و روز برایش مساوی بود. او در خواب دید که گویا آنقدر به خورشید نزدیک شده که دو طرف شرق و غرب آن را به دست گرفته است، وقتی که این رؤیای خود را برای قومش تعریف کرد در میان آنان عزیز گردید و او را «ذوالقرنین» نامیدند. او هم آنان را به‌سوی خدا دعوت کرد و آنان هم قبول کرده و تسلیم حق گردیدند، آنگاه امرشان کرد که برایش مسجدی بنا کنند و آنان نیز اجابت کردند، سپس دستور داد که طول آن را چهار صد ذراع و عرض آن را دویست ذراع و قطر دیوارش را بیست و دو ذراع و ارتفاعش را صد ذراع قرار دهند». مردم گفتند: «برای چوبی که بین دو دیوار برسد [جهت ساختن سقف] چه می‌اندیشی»؟ گفت: «هرگاه از ساختن دیوارها فارغ شدید آنجا را پر از خاک کنید تا به‌اندازه‌ی دیوار مسجد برسد، مقداری از طلا و نقره مانن-د تراشه‌ی قلم تکه کنید و با خاک‌ها مخلوط نمایید و برای آن چوبه‌هایی از مس و ورق‌هایی از مس بسازید سپس آن‌ها را ذوب کرده و این کار برای شما بر زمین مسطح راحت‌تر و میسّر است. و وقتی از آن فارغ شدید، مردم بینوا و درمانده را برای بیرون‌آوردن خاک‌ها بخوانید و از آنجا که در میان خاک‌ها طلا و نقره است، برای این کار پیشی و سرعت می‌گیرند. وقتی که مسجد را ساختند و بینوایان خاک‌ها را بیرون بردند، این درحالی بود که سقف به خاطر مصالح استفاده شده در آن، آماده شده بود و فقرا و بینوایان هم بی‌نیاز شدند، آنگاه ذو القرنین آنان را به چهار لشکر در هر لشکر ده هزار نفر تقسیم کرد و آنان را در سرزمین‌های مختلف پراکنده ساخت».
86.en: Ali (peace be upon him) was asked about Dhu al-Qarnayn: "How was he able to reach the East and the West?" He replied: "God subjugated the clouds for him, facilitated the means for him, spread light for him, and the night and day were equal for him. He saw in a dream as if he had drawn so close to the sun that he grasped its horns in its east and its west. When he recounted his vision to his people, they recognized him and named him Dhu al-Qarnayn (The Two-Horned One). He invited them to God, and they accepted and submitted. Then he ordered them to build a mosque for him, and they complied. He commanded them to make its length four hundred cubits, its width two hundred cubits, and its height toward the sky one hundred cubits." They asked: "How will you find timbers that reach across the space between the two walls?" He said: "When you finish building the walls, fill the interior with earth until it is level with the walls of the mosque. When you have finished that, take gold and silver in equal measure, cut them into pieces like nail clippings, and mix them into that earth. Then, fashion beams and plates of copper for it, melting them down while you are able to work as you wish, standing on level ground. When you have finished that, call the poor to remove that earth; they will hasten to do so because of the gold and silver within it. Thus, they built the mosque, and the poor removed the earth, leaving the roof standing, and the poor became wealthy. He then organized them into four armies, each consisting of ten thousand men, and dispersed them throughout the lands."
86.book: Tafsir Ahl al-Bayt (peace be upon them), Vol. 8, p. 602
86.refs: Nur al-Thaqalayn / Bihar al-Anwar, Vol. 12, p. 193 and al-Burhan; "And he saw... until the end" is omitted.

86.ar: امیرالمؤمنین (- قَالَ أمِیرُالمُؤمِنین (تَغْرُبُ الشَّمْسُ فِی عَیْنٍ حَامِیَةٍ فِی بَحْرٍ دُونَ الْمَدِینَةِ الَّتِی مِمَّا یَلِی الْمَغْرِبَ یَعْنِی جَابُلْقَا.
86.fa: از امام باقر (علیه السلام) روایت است که امیرالؤمنین (علیه السلام) فرمود: «تَغْرُبُ الشَّمْسُ فِی عَیْنٍ حَامِیَةٍ؛ در دریایی فروتر از شهری که پهلوی مغرب است یعنی شهر جابلقا».
86.en: The sun sets in a hot spring in a sea below the city that is adjacent to the west, meaning Jabulqa.
86.refs: Bihar al-Anwar, vol. 12, p. 199; Nur al-Thaqalayn; al-Burhan

87.ar: امیرالمؤمنین (- عَنِ الْأَصْبَغِ بْنِ نُبَاتَةَ عَنْ أمیرالمومنین (قَال ... أَمَّا مَنْ ظَلَمَ وَ لَمْ یُؤْمِنْ بِرَبِّهِ فَسَوْفَ نُعَذِّبُهُ فِی الدُّنْیَا بِعَذَابِ الدُّنْیَا ثُمَّ یُرَدُّ إِلی رَبِّهِ فِی مَرْجِعِهِ فَیُعَذِّبُهُ عَذاباً نُکْرا.
87.fa: امّا کسی را که ستم کرده است و به پروردگارش ایمان نیاورد، در دنیا با عذاب دنیا مجازات خواهیم کرد. سپس در بازگشت خود به‌سوی پروردگارش باز گردانده می‌شود و خدا او را مجازات شدیدی خواهد کرد!
87.en: As for him who has done wrong and did not believe in his Lord, We shall punish him in the world with the punishment of the world; then he shall be returned to his Lord in his return, and He will punish him with a severe punishment.
87.book: Tafsir Ahl al-Bayt (peace be upon them), Vol. 8, p. 604
87.refs: Bihar al-Anwar, Vol. 12, p. 198; Al-Ayyashi, Vol. 2, p. 341

87.ar: الصّادق (- عَنْ أَبِی بَصِیرٍ عَنْ أَبِی عَبْدِ اللَّهِ (قَال: عَذاباً نُکْراً قَالَ فِی النَّارِ فَجَعَلَ ذُوالْقَرْنَیْنِ بَیْنَهُمْ بَاباً مِنْ نُحَاسٍ وَ حَدِیدٍ وَ زِفْتٍ وَ قَطِرَانٍ فَحَالَ بَیْنَهُمْ وَ بَیْنَ الْخُرُوج.
87.fa: ابوبصیر نقل می‌کند: امام صادق (علیه السلام) فرمود: مجازات شدیدی در آتش بود. ذو القرنین با مس و آهن و قیر و قطران در برابر آن‌ها دری ساخت و جلوی خروج آن‌ها را گرفت.
87.en: Abu Basir narrates: Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) said regarding "a severe punishment" (18:87): It is in the Fire. Dhu al-Qarnayn made a gate between them [and the outside] out of copper, iron, pitch, and tar, and thus prevented them from coming out.
87.book: Tafsir Ahl al-Bayt (peace be upon them), vol. 8, p. 604
87.refs: Bihar al-Anwar, vol. 12, p. 177; Al-Qummi, vol. 2, p. 40

87.ar: الصّادق (- قَالَ الصَّادِقَ (اللَّهُمَّ الْعَنْ قَتَلَةَ الْحُسَیْنِ بْنِ عَلِیٍّ (وَ قَتَلَةَ أَنْصَارِ الْحُسَیْنِ بْنِ عَلِیٍّ (وَ أَصْلِهِمْ حَرَّ نَارِکَ وَ أَذِقْهُمْ بَأْسَکَ وَ ضَاعِفْ عَلَیْهِمْ عَذَابَکَ وَ الْعَنْهُمْ لَعْناً وَبِیلًا اللَّهُمَّ أَحْلِلْ بِهِمْ نَقِمَتَکَ وَ أْتِهِمْ مِنْ حَیْثُ لَا یَحْتَسِبُونَ وَ خُذْهُمْ مِنْ حَیْثُ لا یَشْعُرُونَ وَ عَذِّبْهُمْ عَذاباً نُکْراً.
87.fa: خدایا قاتلان حسین‌بن‌علی (علیه السلام) را لعنت کن، و نیز قاتلان یاران حسین‌بن‌علی (علیه السلام) را مورد لعن خود قرار بده، و حرارت آتش جهنّم خود را به ایشان برسان، و عذابت را به آن‌ها بچشان، عذابشان مجازات شدیدی بود.
87.en: O Allah, curse the killers of al-Husayn ibn Ali and the killers of the companions of al-Husayn ibn Ali. Subject them to the heat of Your Fire, make them taste Your might, multiply Your punishment upon them, and curse them with a grievous curse. O Allah, inflict Your vengeance upon them, come upon them from where they do not expect, seize them from where they do not perceive, and punish them with a severe punishment.

88.ar: الرّسول (- قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ (أَتَانِی جَبْرَئِیلَ (عنْ رَبِّهِ عَزَّ وَ جَلَّ وَ هُوَ یَقُولُ رَبِّی یُقْرِئُکَ السَّلَامَ وَ یَقُولُ لَکَ یا محمد (بَشِّرِ الْمُؤْمِنِینَ الَّذِینَ یَعْمَلُونَ الصَّالِحَاتِ وَ یُؤْمِنُونَ بِکَ وَ بِأَهْلِ بَیْتِکَ بِالْجَنَّةِ وَ لَهُمْ عِنْدِی جَزَاءُ الْحُسْنَی یَدْخُلُونَ الْجَنَّةَ.
88.en: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) said: "Gabriel came to me from my Lord, the Almighty and Majestic, and he said: 'Your Lord sends you greetings and says to you: O Muhammad, give glad tidings to the believers who perform righteous deeds and believe in you and in your Ahl al-Bayt, of Paradise. They shall have with Me the reward of the best, and they shall enter Paradise.'"
88.book: Tafsir Ahl al-Bayt (peace be upon them), Vol. 8, p. 604
88.refs: Bihar al-Anwar, Vol. 24, p. 269; Ta'wil al-Ayat al-Zahirah, p. 290

89.ar: امیرالمؤمنین (- عَنِ الْأَصْبَغِ بْنِ نُبَاتَةَ عَنْ أَمِیرِ الْمُؤْمِنِینَ (قَالَ: قَوْلِهِ وَ سَنَقُولُ لَهُ مِنْ أَمْرِنا یُسْراً ثُمَّ أَتْبَعَ سَبَباً ذُو الْقَرْنَیْنِ مِنَ الشَّمْسِ سَبَباً ثُمَّ قَالَ أمیرالمؤمنین (إِنَّ ذَاالْقَرْنَیْنِ لَمَّا انْتَهَی مَعَ الشَّمْسِ إِلَی الْعَیْنِ الْحَامِیَةِ وَجَدَ الشَّمْسَ تَغْرُبُ فِیهَا وَ مَعَهَا سَبْعُونَ أَلْفَ مَلَکٍ یَجُرُّونَهَا بِسَلَاسِلِ الْحَدِیدِ وَ الْکَلَالِیبِ یَجُرُّونَهَا مِنْ قَعْرِ الْبَحْرِ فِی قُطْرِ الْأَرْضِ الْأَیْمَنِ کَمَا یَجْرِی السَّفِینَةُ عَلَی ظَهْرِ الْمَاءِ فَلَمَّا انْتَهَی مَعَهَا إِلَی مَطْلَعِ الشَّمْسِ سَبَباً وَجَدَها تَطْلُعُ عَلی قَوْمٍ إِلَی بِما لَدَیْهِ خُبْراً فَقَالَ أمِیرِالمُؤمِنین (إِنَّ ذَاالْقَرْنَیْنِ وَرَدَ عَلَی قَوْمٍ قَدْ أَحْرَقَتْهُمُ الشَّمْسُ وَ غَیَّرَتْ أَجْسَادَهُمْ وَ أَلْوَانَهُمْ حَتَّی صَیَّرَتْهُمْ کَالظُّلْمَةِ ثُمَّ أَتْبَعَ ذُوالْقَرْنَیْنِ سَبَباً فِی نَاحِیَةِ الظُّلْمَةِ حَتَّی إِذا بَلَغَ بَیْنَ السَّدَّیْنِ وَجَدَ مِنْ دُونِهِما قَوْماً لا یَکادُونَ یَفْقَهُونَ قَوْلا.
89.en: Al-Asbagh ibn Nubatah narrates from the Commander of the Faithful (peace be upon him) regarding the verse: "And We shall say to him of Our command, ease" (18:88), followed by: "Then he followed a way" (18:89). The Commander of the Faithful said: "Dhu al-Qarnayn followed a sign of the sun." He then said: "When Dhu al-Qarnayn reached the murky spring (al-ayn al-hamiyah) with the sun, he found the sun setting into it, accompanied by seventy thousand angels who were pulling it with iron chains and hooks. They were pulling it from the depths of the sea across the right side of the earth, just as a ship sails upon the surface of the water. When he reached the rising place of the sun with it, he found it rising upon a people for whom We had provided no shelter from it. The Commander of the Faithful said: 'Dhu al-Qarnayn came upon a people whom the sun had scorched, altering their bodies and their complexions until it had turned them dark.' Then Dhu al-Qarnayn followed a way in the direction of the darkness until he reached between the two barriers, where he found beside them a people who could hardly understand any speech."
89.book: Tafsir Ahl al-Bayt (peace be upon them), Vol. 8, p. 606
89.refs: Bihar al-Anwar, Vol. 12, p. 198; al-Ayyashi, Vol. 2, p. 341

89.ar: امیرالمؤمنین (- عَنْ أمِیرِالمُؤمِنین (ثُمَّ أَتْبَعَ سَبَباً أَیْ دَلِیلًا.
89.fa: ثُمَّ أَتْبَعَ سَبَباً یعنی یک دلیل.
89.en: "Then he followed a way" (18:89) means a guide/reason.
89.book: Tafsir Ahl al-Bayt (peace be upon them), Vol. 8, p. 606

92.ar: امیرالمؤمنین (- عَنِ الْأَصْبَغِ بْنِ نُبَاتَةَ عَنْ أَمِیرِ الْمُؤْمِنِینَ (قَالَ: فَلَمَّا انْتَهَی مَعَهَا إِلَی مَطْلَعِ الشَّمْسِ سَبَباً وَجَدَها تَطْلُعُ عَلی قَوْمٍ إِلَی بِما لَدَیْهِ خُبْراً فَقَالَ أمیرالمومنین (إِنَّ ذَاالْقَرْنَیْنِ وَرَدَ عَلَی قَوْمٍ قَدْ أَحْرَقَتْهُمُ الشَّمْسُ وَ غَیَّرَتْ أَجْسَادَهُمْ وَ أَلْوَانَهُمْ حَتَّی صَیَّرَتْهُمْ کَالظُّلْمَة.
92.fa: وقتی ذوالقرنین همراه خورشید به محلّ طلوع خورشید رسید، [در آنجا] دید خورشید بر جمعیّتی طلوع می‌کند که در برابر [تابش] آفتاب، پوششی برای آن‌ها قرار نداده بودیم. [و سایبانی نداشتند]. امیرالمؤمنین (علیه السلام) فرمود: «ذوالقرنین نزد کسانی رفت که خورشید آنان را سوزانده بود و جسدها و رنگشان را تغییر داده و سیاه کرده بود و سپس او در منطقه‌ی تاریکی به‌دنبال یک نشانه و راهنما به راه افتاد».
92.en: Al-Asbagh ibn Nubatah narrated from the Commander of the Faithful (peace be upon him) regarding the verse: "When he reached the rising place of the sun, he found it rising upon a people for whom We had provided no shelter against it." The Commander of the Faithful said: "Dhu al-Qarnayn came upon a people whom the sun had scorched, altering their bodies and their complexions until it had rendered them like darkness. Then he set out in the region of darkness in search of a sign and a guide."
92.book: Tafsir Ahl al-Bayt (peace be upon them), Vol. 8, p. 606
92.refs: Bihar al-Anwar, Vol. 12, p. 198 / Al-Ayyashi, Vol. 2, p. 341

92.ar: الصّادق (- عَنْ إِبْرَاهِیمَ بْنِ أَبِی سَمَّاکٍ عَنْ رَجُلٍ عَنْ أَبِی عَبْدِ اللَّهِ (فِی قَوْلِ اللَّهِ فَلَمَّا بَلَغَ مَطْلِعَ الشَّمْسِ وَجَدَها تَطْلُعُ عَلی قَوْمٍ لَمْ نَجْعَلْ لَهُمْ مِنْ دُونِها سِتْراً قَالَ لَمْ یَعْلَمُوا صَنْعَةَ الْبِنَاءِ.
92.fa: ابراهیم‌بن‌سمّاک از شخصی نقل می‌کند: امام صادق (علیه السلام) درباره‌ی سخن خداوند متعال: فَلَمَّا بَلَغَ مَطْلِعَ الشَّمْسِ وَجَدَها تَطْلُعُ عَلی قَوْمٍ لَمْ نَجْعَلْ لَهُمْ مِنْ دُونِها سِتْراً، فرمود: «آن‌ها صنعت ساختمان سازی را نمی‌دانستند».
92.en: Ibrahim ibn Abi Sammak narrates from a man, from Abu Abd Allah (Imam al-Sadiq), regarding the words of Allah, the Exalted: "Until, when he reached the rising of the sun, he found it rising on a people for whom We had provided no shelter against it" (18:90), he said: "They did not know the craft of building."
92.book: Tafsir Ahl al-Bayt (peace be upon them), Vol. 8, p. 606
92.refs: Bihar al-Anwar, Vol. 12, p. 183; Al-Mahasin, Vol. 2, p. 610

92.ar: الباقر (- عَنْ أَبِی بَصِیرٍ عَنْ أَبِی جَعْفَرٍ (فِی قَوْلِ اللَّهِ لَمْ نَجْعَلْ لَهُمْ مِنْ دُونِها سِتْراً کَذَلِکَ قَالَ لَمْ یَعْلَمُوا صَنْعَةَ الْبُیُوتِ.
92.fa: از ابوبصیر روایت است که امام باقر (علیه السلام) در معنای این آیه: لَمْ نَجْعَلْ لَهُمْ مِنْ دُونِها سِتْراً کَذلِکَ؛ فرمود: «آن‌ها ساختن خانه را نمیدانستند».
92.en: It is narrated from Abu Basir that Imam al-Baqir (peace be upon him), regarding the saying of Allah: "We had not given them any shelter against it," said: "They did not know how to construct houses."
92.book: Tafsir Ahl al-Bayt (peace be upon them), Vol. 8, p. 608
92.refs: Bihar al-Anwar, Vol. 12, p. 206 / Al-Ayyashi, Vol. 2, p. 350

92.fa: آن‌ها ساختن خانه را نمیدانستند.
92.en: They did not know how to construct houses.
92.book: Tafsir Ahl al-Bayt (peace be upon them), Vol. 8, p. 608

92.en: They did not know the craft of making clothes.
92.book: Tafsir Ahl al-Bayt (peace be upon them), Vol. 8, p. 608

92.ar: المهدی (- عَنْ أَبِی الْحُسَیْنِ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ جَعْفَرٍ الْأَسَدِیِّ قَالَ: کَانَ فِیمَا یُورَدُ عَلَیَّ مِنَ الشَّیْخِ أَبِی جَعْفَرٍ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عُثْمَانَ الْعَمْرِیِّ قَدَّسَ اللَّهُ رُوحَهُ فِی جَوَابِ مَسَائِلِی إِلَی صَاحِبِ الزَّمَانِ: وَ أَمَّا مَا سَأَلْتَ عَنْهُ مِنَ الصَّلَاةِ عِنْدَ طُلُوعِ الشَّمْسِ وَ عِنْدَ غُرُوبِهَا وَ لَئِنْ کَانَ کَمَا یَقُولُونَ: إِنَّ الشَّمْسَ تَطْلُعُ بَیْنَ قَرْنَیِ الشَّیْطَانِ وَ تَغِیبُ بَیْنَ قَرْنَیِ الشَّیْطَانِ. فَلَا شَیْءَ أَفْضَلُ مِنَ الصَّلَاةِ وَ أَرْغَمُ أَنْفِ الشَّیْطَانِ.
92.fa: ابوالحسین محمّدبن‌جعفر اسدی گوید: در ضمن جواب مسائلی که من از حضرت صاحب الزمان (عجل الله تعالی فرجه الشریف) پرسیده بودم و محمّدبن‌عثمان برای من فرستاد، مرقوم بود که: «و امّا اینکه از نماز هنگام طلوع و غروب خورشید پرسیده‌ای؛ اگر امر چنین باشد که گفته‌اند خورشید از بین دو شاخ شیطان طلوع می‌کند و از بین دو شاخ شیطان غروب می‌کند، چیزی مثل نماز بینی شیطان را به خاک نمی‌مالد؛ پس در این دو وقت نماز بخوان و بینی شیطان را به خاک بمال».
92.en: Abu al-Husayn Muhammad ibn Ja'far al-Asadi said: Among the responses to the questions I had asked of the Master of the Age (may Allah hasten his noble reappearance), which were sent to me by Shaykh Abu Ja'far Muhammad ibn Uthman al-Amri (may Allah sanctify his soul), was the following: "As for what you asked regarding prayer at the time of sunrise and sunset: even if it is as they say—that the sun rises between the two horns of Satan and sets between the two horns of Satan—there is nothing better than prayer to rub the nose of Satan in the dust. So, perform prayer at these two times and rub the nose of Satan in the dust."
92.book: Tafsir Ahl al-Bayt (peace be upon them), Vol. 8, p. 608

93.ar: الصّادق (- إِنَّ ذَاالْقَرْنَیْنِ لَمَّا انْتَهَی إِلَی السَّدِّ جَاوَزَهُ فَدَخَلَ فِی الظُّلُمَاتِ فَإِذَا هُوَ بِمَلَکٍ قَائِمٍ عَلَی جَبَلٍ طُولُهُ خَمْسُمِائَةِ ذِرَاعٍ فَقَالَ لَهُ الْمَلَکُ یَا ذَاالْقَرْنَیْنِ أَ مَا کَانَ خَلْفَکَ مَسْلَکٌ فَقَالَ لَهُ ذُوالْقَرْنَیْنِ مَنْ أَنْتَ قَالَ أَنَا مَلَکٌ مِنْ مَلَائِکَةِ الرَّحْمَنِ مُوَکَّلٌ بِهَذَا الْجَبَلِ فَلَیْسَ مِنْ جَبَلٍ خَلَقَهُ اللَّهُ عَزَّ وَ جَلَّ إِلَّا وَ لَهُ عِرْقٌ إِلَی هَذَا الْجَبَلِ فَإِذَا أَرَادَ اللَّهُ عَزَّ وَ جَلَّ أَنْ یُزَلْزِلَ مَدِینَةً أَوْحَی إِلَیَّ فَزَلْزَلْتُهَا.
93.fa: چون ذو القرنین از سد گذشت داخل ظلمات شد و به فرشته‌ای رسید که بر کوهی به طول پانصد ذراع ایستاده بود و به ذو القرنین گفت: «مگر پشت سرت راه نبود»؟ ذوالقرنین به او گفت: «تو کیستی»؟ گفت: «یکی از فرشتگان رحمانم و موکّل بر این کوهم که از هر کوهی رگی به این کوه متّصل است و هنگامی‌که خدا بخواهد شهری را بلرزاند به من وحی می‌کند تا آن را بلرزانم».
93.en: When Dhu al-Qarnayn passed the barrier, he entered the darkness and encountered an angel standing upon a mountain five hundred cubits tall. The angel said to him, "O Dhu al-Qarnayn, was there not a path behind you?" Dhu al-Qarnayn asked him, "Who are you?" He replied, "I am one of the angels of the Most Merciful, appointed over this mountain. There is no mountain that Allah, the Almighty and Majestic, has created but that it has a vein connected to this mountain. When Allah, the Almighty and Majestic, intends to shake a city, He reveals it to me, and I cause it to shake."
93.book: Tafsir Ahl al-Bayt (peace be upon them), Vol. 8, p. 608
93.refs: Bihar al-Anwar, Vol. 12, p. 180; Nur al-Thaqalayn; al-Burhan

94.ar: امیرالمؤمنین (- حَتَّی إِذا بَلَغَ بَیْنَ السَّدَّیْنِ وَجَدَ مِنْ دُونِهِما قَوْماً لا یَکادُونَ یَفْقَهُونَ قَوْلًا. قالُوا یا ذَاالْقَرْنَیْنِ إِنَّ یَأْجُوجَ وَ مَأْجُوجَ خَلْفَ هَذَیْنِ الْجَبَلَیْنِ وَ هُمْ یُفْسِدُونَ فِی الْأَرْضِ إِذَا کَانَ إِبَّانُ زُرُوعِنَا وَ ثِمَارِنَا خَرَجُوا عَلَیْنَا مِنْ هَذَیْنِ السَّدَّیْنِ فَرَعَوْا فِی ثِمَارِنَا وَ زُرُوعِنَا حَتَّی لَا یُبْقُوْنَ مِنْهَا شَیْئاً فَهَلْ نَجْعَلُ لَکَ خَرْجاً نُؤَدِّیهِ إِلَیْکَ فِی کُلِّ عَامٍ عَلی أَنْ تَجْعَلَ بَیْنَنا وَ بَیْنَهُمْ سَدًّا.
94.fa: [و همچنان به راه خود ادامه داد] تا هنگامی‌که به میان دو کوه رسید؛ و در کنار آن دو [کوه] قومی را یافت که هیچ سخنی را نمی‌فهمیدند [و زبانشان مخصوص خودشان بود]. ای ذوالقرنین! [قوم] یأجوج و مأجوج در پشت این دو کوه هستند و چون زمان برداشت محصول ما فرارسد، آنان از پشت این دو سد بیرون آمده و تمام کشت و محصولات ما را می‌خورند و چیزی از آن را باقی نمیگذارند. آیا ممکن است ما هزینه‌ای برای تو قرار دهیم و در هر سال آن خراج را به تو پرداخت کنیم که میان ما و آن‌ها سدّی ایجاد کنی»؟!
94.en: "Until, when he reached between the two barriers, he found beside them a people who could hardly understand speech. They said, 'O Dhul-Qarnayn! Indeed, Gog and Magog are behind these two mountains, and they cause corruption in the land. When the time for our crops and fruits arrives, they emerge upon us from these two barriers and graze upon our fruits and crops, leaving nothing of them behind. So, may we assign for you a tribute that we pay to you each year, provided that you build a barrier between us and them?'"
94.book: Tafsir Ahl al-Bayt (peace be upon them), Vol. 8, p. 608
94.refs: Bihar al-Anwar, Vol. 12, p. 198 / Al-Ayyashi, Vol. 2, p. 341

94.ar: الصّادق (- عَنْ أَبِی بَصِیرٍ عَنْ أَبِی عَبْدِ اللَّهِ (قَالَ: لَیْسَ مِنْهُمْ رَجُلٌ یَمُوتُ حَتَّی یُولَدَ لَهُ مِنْ صُلْبِهِ أَلْفُ ذَکَرٍ ثُمَّ قَالَ هُمْ أَکْثَرُ خَلْقٍ خُلِقُوا بَعْدَ الْمَلَائِکَةِ.
94.fa: ابوبصیر نقل می‌کند: امام صادق (علیه السلام) فرمود: «هرکس از آنان (قوم ذوالقرنین) از دنیا میرفت، هزار پسر از نسل او زاده می‌شد». سپس فرمود: «آن‌ها پس از فرشتگان، بیشترین جمعیّت مخلوقات را داشتند».
94.en: Abu Basir narrates that Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) said: "Not a single man among them (the people of Dhu al-Qarnayn) would die until a thousand sons were born from his loins." Then he said: "They are the most numerous of the creatures created after the angels."
94.book: Tafsir Ahl al-Bayt (peace be upon them), Vol. 8, p. 610
94.refs: Bihar al-Anwar, Vol. 12, p. 178; Nur al-Thaqalayn

94.ar: الصّادق (- الدُّنْیَا سَبْعَةُ أَقَالِیمَ یَأْجُوجُ وَ مَأْجُوجُ وَ الرُّومُ وَ الصِّینُ وَ الزَّنْجُ وَ قَوْمُ مُوسَی وَ أَقَالِیمُ بَابِلَ.
94.fa: دنیا هفت اقلیم است؛ یأجوج و مأجوج، روم، چین، زنج، قوم موسی (علیه السلام) و اقالیم بابل.
94.en: The world consists of seven regions: Gog and Magog, Rome, China, Zanj, the people of Moses (peace be upon him), and the regions of Babylon.
94.book: Tafsir Ahl al-Bayt (peace be upon them), vol. 8, p. 610
94.refs: Bihar al-Anwar, vol. 57, p. 118; Nur al-Thaqalayn

94.ar: ابن عبّاس (- سُئِلَ أَمِیرُ الْمُؤْمِنِینَ (عَنِ الْخَلْقِ فَقَالَ خَلَقَ اللَّهُ أَلْفاً وَ مِائَتَیْنِ فِی الْبَرِّ وَ أَلْفاً وَ مِائَتَیْنِ فِی الْبَحْرِ وَ أَجْنَاسُ بَنِی آدَمَ سَبْعُونَ جِنْساً وَ النَّاسُ وُلْدُ آدَمَ مَا خَلَا یَأْجُوجَ وَ مَأْجُوجَ.
94.fa: از امیر المؤمنین (علیه السلام) درباره‌ی آفرینش پرسیده شد، فرمود: «خدا هزارودویست در خشکی آفریده و هزارودویست در دریا و هفتاد جنس از بنی‌آدم، و همه‌ی مردم به جز یأجوج و مأجوج فرزندان آدم (علیه السلام) هستند».
94.en: The Commander of the Faithful (peace be upon him) was asked about creation, and he said: "God created twelve hundred in the land and twelve hundred in the sea, and there are seventy species of the children of Adam; and all people, except for Gog and Magog, are the descendants of Adam (peace be upon him)."
94.book: Tafsir Ahl al-Bayt (peace be upon them), Vol. 8, p. 610
94.refs: Al-Kafi, Vol. 8, p. 220; Al-Burhan; Nur al-Thaqalayn

94.ar: الرّسول (- عَنْ حُذَیْفَةَ بْنِ الْیَمَانِ عَنِ النَّبِیِّ (عَنْ أَهْلِ یَأْجُوجَ وَ مَأْجُوجَ قَالَ إِنَّ الْقَوْمَ لَیَنْقُرُونَ بِمَعَاوِلِهِمْ دَائِبِینَ فَإِذَا کَانَ اللَّیْلُ قَالُوا غَداً نَفْرُغُ فَیُصْبِحُونَ وَ هُوَ أَقْوَی مِنَ الْأَمْسِ حَتَّی یُسْلِمَ مِنْهُمْ رَجُلٌ حِینَ یُرِیدُ اللَّهُ أَنْ یَبْلُغَ أَمْرَهُ فَیَقُولُ الْمُؤْمِنُ غَداً نَفْتَحُهُ إِنْ شَاءَ اللَّهُ فَیُصْبِحُونَ ثُمَّ یَغْدُونَ عَلَیْهِ فَیَفْتَحُهُ اللَّهُ فَوَ الَّذِی نَفْسِی بِیَدِهِ لَیَمُرَّنَ الرَّجُلُ مِنْهُمْ عَلَی شَاطِئِ الْوَادِی الَّذِی بِکُوفَانَ وَ قَدْ شَرِبُوهُ حَتَّی نَزَحُوهُ فَیَقُولُ وَ اللَّهِ لَقَدْ رَأَیْتُ هَذَا الْوَادِیَ مَرَّةً وَ إِنَّ الْمَاءَ لَیَجْرِی فِی أَرْضِهِ قِیلَ یَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ وَ مَتَی هَذَا قَالَ حِینَ لَا یَبْقَی مِنَ الدُّنْیَا إِلَّا مِثْلُ صُبَابَةِ الْإِنَاء.
94.fa: حذیفه‌بن‌یمان نقل می‌کند که رسول خدا (صلی الله علیه و آله) درباره‌ی قوم یأجوج و مأجوج فرمود: «آنان قومی بودند که همواره با کلنگهایشان سد را می‌کوبیدند و چون شب میشد، می‌گفتند: «فردا این کار را تمام خواهیم کرد». فردای آن روز که فرا می‌رسید، می‌دیدند که سد نسبت به دیروز محکم‌تر است. تا اینکه یکی از آنان ایمان آورد و آن هنگامی بود که خداوند اراده نمود که فرمان خود را تحقّق بخشد. دراین‌هنگام آن فرد مؤمن گفت: «به خواست خداوند، فردا سد را خواهیم گشود». چون فردای آن روز، صبح هنگام به‌سراغ سد رفتند، خداوند آن سد را گشود. سوگند به آن کس که جانم در کف اوست، این مرد بر کرانه‌ی دشت کوفه خواهد گذشت درحالی‌که آن قوم، آن قدر آب از آن کشیده‌اند تا آن را خشک کرده‌اند. آنگاه آن مرد مؤمن گوید: «به خدا سوگند که من این دشت را یک‌بار دیدهام». و اکنون آب در پهنه‌ی این دشت روان است». عرض شد: «ای رسول خدا (صلی الله علیه و آله)! این چه زمانی روی خواهد داد»؟ فرمود: «زمانی‌که از دنیا جز چیزی اندک همچون ته مانده‌ی آب در ظرف باقی نمانده باشد».
94.en: Hudhayfah ibn al-Yaman narrates that the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) said regarding the people of Gog and Magog: "They are a people who constantly strike the barrier with their pickaxes, working diligently. When night falls, they say, 'We shall finish tomorrow.' They wake up the next morning to find it stronger than it was the day before. This continues until one of them believes, at the time when Allah intends to fulfill His command. The believer says, 'By the will of Allah, we shall open it tomorrow.' When they return the next morning, Allah opens it for them. By the One in whose hand is my soul, a man among them will pass by the bank of the valley of Kufan, and they will have drunk so much of it that they will have drained it. He will say, 'By Allah, I once saw this valley when water was flowing through its land.' It was asked, 'O Messenger of Allah! When will this happen?' He replied, 'When there remains of the world only as much as the dregs at the bottom of a vessel.'"
94.book: Tafsir Ahl al-Bayt (peace be upon them), Vol. 8, p. 610

94.ar: العسکری (- عَنْ عَبْدِ الْعَظِیمِ الْحَسَنِیِّ قَالَ سَمِعْتُ عَلِیَّ بْنَ مُحَمَّدٍ الْعَسْکَرِیَّ (یَقُولُ عَاشَ نُوحٌ (أَلْفَیْنِ وَ خَمْسَمِائَةِ سَنَةٍ وَ کَانَ یَوْماً فِی السَّفِینَةِ نَائِماً فَهَبَّتْ رِیحٌ فَکَشَفَتْ عَوْرَتَهُ فَضَحِکَ حَامٌ وَ یَافِثُ فَزَجَرَهُمَا سَامٌ وَ نَهَاهُمَا عَنِ الضَّحِکِ وَ کَانَ کُلَّمَا غَطَّی سَامٌ شَیْئاً تَکْشِفُهُ الرِّیحُ کَشَفَهُ حَامٌ وَ یَافِثُ فَانْتَبَهَ نُوحٌ (فَرَآهُمْ وَ هُمْ یَضْحَکُونَ فَقَالَ مَا هَذَا فَأَخْبَرَهُ سَامٌ بِمَا کَانَ فَرَفَعَ نُوحٌ (یَدَهُ إِلَی السَّمَاءِ یَدْعُو وَ یَقُولُ اللَّهُمَّ غَیِّرْ مَاءَ صُلْبِ حَامٍ حَتَّی لَا یُولَدَ لَهُ إِلَّا السُّودَانُ اللَّهُمَّ غَیِّرْ مَاءَ صُلْبِ یَافِثَ فَغَیَّرَ اللَّهُ مَاءَ صُلْبَیْهِمَا فَجَمِیعُ السُّودَانِ حَیْثُ کَانُوا مِنْ حَامٍ وَ جَمِیعُ التُّرْکِ وَ الصَّقَالِبَةِ وَ یَأْجُوجَ وَ مَأْجُوجَ وَ الصِّینِ مِنْ یَافِثَ حَیْثُ کَانُوا وَ جَمِیعُ الْبِیضِ سِوَاهُمْ مِنْ سَامٍ وَ قَالَ نُوحٌ لِحَامٍ وَ یَافِثَ جُعِلَ ذُرِّیَّتُکُمَا خَوَلًا لِذُرِّیَةِ سَامٍ إِلَی یَوْمِ الْقِیَامَةِ لِأَنَّهُ بَرَّ بِی وَ عَقَقْتُمَانِی فَلَا زَالَتْ سِمَةُ عُقُوقِکُمَا لِی فِی ذُرِّیَّتِکُمَا ظَاهِرَةً وَ سِمَةُ الْبِرِّ بِی فِی ذُرِّیَّةِ سَامٍ ظَاهِرَةً مَا بَقِیَتِ الدُّنْیَا.
94.fa: عبدالعظیم حسنی گوید: شنیدم امام هادی (علیه السلام) فرمود: «نوح (علیه السلام) درهزاروپانصد سال زیست و روزی در کشتی خواب بود و باد وزید و عورتش آشکار شد و حام و یافث خندیدند و سام به آن‌ها تشر زد و از خنده باز داشت، و هرچه را که باد فاش کرده بود، سام می‌پوشاند [اما] حام و یافث آن را پدیدار می‌کردند. نوح (علیه السلام) بیدار شد و دید می‌خندند، فرمود: «چه شده است»؟ سام آنچه شده بود به ایشان گزارش داد، نوح (علیه السلام) دست به آسمان برداشت و دعا کرد و می‌گفت: «بار خدایا آب پشت سام را دگرگون ساز تا جز سیاهان فرزند نیاورد، بار خدایا آب پشت یافث را دگرگون ساز». و خدا آب پشت آن‌ها را دگرگون ساخت، و همه‌ی سیاهان هرجا باشند از حامند، و همه ترک و صقالبه و یأجوج و مأجوج و چین هرجا باشند از یافث، و سفیدپوستان همه از سام. نوح (علیه السلام) به حام و یافث فرمود: «نژاد ش-ماه-ا تا ق-یامت بردگان فرزندان سامند زیرا او به من نیکی کرد و شما ناسپاسی من کردید، و پیوسته نشانه‌ی ناسپاسی شما در نژادتان روشن است، و نشانه‌ی خوشرفتاری در نژاد سام تا دنیا به‌جا است روشن است».
94.en: Abd al-Azim al-Hasani said: I heard Ali ibn Muhammad al-Askari (peace be upon him) say: "Noah (peace be upon him) lived for two thousand and five hundred years. One day, while he was asleep on the Ark, a wind blew and uncovered his private parts. Ham and Japheth laughed, but Shem rebuked them and forbade them from laughing. Whenever Shem would cover what the wind had uncovered, Ham and Japheth would uncover it again. Noah (peace be upon him) awoke and saw them laughing, so he asked, 'What is this?' Shem informed him of what had happened. Noah (peace be upon him) raised his hands to the heavens, praying and saying: 'O Allah, change the seed of Ham so that he may beget none but the black-skinned. O Allah, change the seed of Japheth.' Allah then changed the seed of both of them. Thus, all black-skinned people, wherever they may be, are from Ham; all the Turks, Slavs, Gog and Magog, and the Chinese, wherever they may be, are from Japheth; and all white-skinned people, other than them, are from Shem. Noah (peace be upon him) said to Ham and Japheth: 'Your descendants are made servants to the descendants of Shem until the Day of Resurrection, because he was dutiful to me while you were undutiful. Therefore, the mark of your disobedience to me shall remain manifest in your descendants, and the mark of dutifulness to me shall remain manifest in the descendants of Shem as long as the world remains.'"
94.book: Tafsir Ahl al-Bayt (peace be upon them), Vol. 8, p. 610

94.ar: امیرالمؤمنین (- عَنْ سَلْمَانَ الْفَارِسِیِّ قَالَ: کُنْتُ أَنَا وَ الْحَسَنُ وَ الْحُسَیْنُ (وَ مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْحَنَفِیَّةِ وَ مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ أَبِی بَکْرٍ وَ عَمَّارُ بْنُ یَاسِرٍ وَ الْمِقْدَادُ بْنُ الْأَسْوَدِ الْکِنْدِیُّ رَضِیَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُمْ فَقَالَ لَهُ ابْنُهُ الْحَسَنُ (یَا أَمِیرَ الْمُؤْمِنِینَ إِنَّ سُلَیْمَانَ بْنَ دَاوُدَ (سَأَلَ رَبَّهُ مُلْکاً لَا یَنْبَغِی لِأَحَدٍ مِنْ بَعْدِهِ فَأَعْطَاهُ ذَلِکَ فَهَلْ مَلَکْتَ مِمَّا مَلَکَ سُلَیْمَانُ بْنُ دَاوُدَ شَیْئاً فَقَالَ (وَ الَّذِی فَلَقَ الْحَبَّةَ وَ بَرَأَ النَّسَمَةَ إِنَّ سُلَیْمَانَ بْنَ دَاوُدَ سَأَلَ اللَّهَ عَزَّ وَ جَلَّ الْمُلْکَ فَأَعْطَاهُ وَ إِنَّ أَبَاکَ مَلَکَ مَا لَمْ یَمْلِکْهُ بَعْدَ جَدِّکَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ (أَحَدٌ قَبْلَهُ وَ لَا یَمْلِکُهُ أَحَدٌ بَعْدَهُ فَقَالَ الْحَسَنُ نُرِیدُ تُرِینَا مِمَّا فَضَّلَکَ اللَّهُ عَزَّ وَ جَلَّ بِهِ مِنَ الْکَرَامَةِ فَقَالَ (أَفْعَلُ إِنْ شَاءَ اللَّهُ فَقَامَ أَمِیرُ الْمُؤْمِنِینَ (وَ تَوَضَّأَ وَ صَلَّی رَکْعَتَیْنِ وَ دَعَا اللَّهَ عَزَّ وَ جَلَّ بِدَعَوَاتٍ لَمْ نَفْهَمْهَا ثُمَّ أَوْمَأَ بِیَدِهِ إِلَی جِهَةِ الْمَغْرِبِ فَمَا کَانَ بِأَسْرَعَ مِنْ أَنْ جَاءَتْ سَحَابَةٌ فَوَقَفَتْ عَلَی الدَّارِ وَ إِلَی جَانِبِهَا سَحَابَةٌ أُخْرَی فَقَالَ أَمِیرُ الْمُؤْمِنِینَ (أَیَّتُهَا السَّحَابَةُ اهْبِطِی بِإِذْنِ اللَّهِ عَزَّ وَ جَلَّ فَهَبَطَتْ وَ هِیَ تَقُولُ أَشْهَدُ أَنْ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَ أَنَّ مُحَمَّداً رَسُولُ اللَّهِ وَ أَنَّکَ خَلِیفَتُهُ وَ وَصِیُّهُ مَنْ شَکَّ فِیکَ فَقَدْ هَلَکَ وَ مَنْ تَمَسَّکَ بِکَ سَلَکَ سَبِیلَ النَّجَاةِ قَالَ ثُمَّ انْبَسَطَتِ السَّحَابَةُ إِلَی الْأَرْضِ حَتَّی کَأَنَّهَا بِسَاطٌ مَوْضُوعٌ فَقَالَ أَمِیرالْمُؤْمِنِینَ (اجْلِسُوا عَلَی الْغَمَامَةِ فَجَلَسْنَا وَ أَخَذْنَا مَوَاضِعَنَا فَأَشَارَ إِلَی السَّحَابَةِ الْأُخْرَی فَهَبَطَتْ وَ هِیَ تَقُولُ کَمَقَالَةِ الْأُولَی وَ جَلَسَ أَمِیرُ الْمُؤْمِنِینَ (عَلَیْهَا مُفْرَدَةً ثُمَّ تَکَلَّمَ بِکَلَامٍ وَ أَشَارَ إِلَیْهَا بِالْمَسِیرِ نَحْوَ الْمَغْرِبِ وَ إِذَا بِالرِّیحِ قَدْ دَخَلَتْ تَحْتَ السَّحَابَتَیْنِ فَرَفَعَتْهُمَا رَفْعاً رَفِیقاً فَتَأَمَّلْتُ نَحْوَ أَمِیرِ الْمُؤْمِنِینَ (وَ إِذَا بِهِ عَلَی کُرْسِیٍّ وَ النُّورُ یَسْطَعُ مِنْ وَجْهِهِ یَکَادُ یَخْطَفُ الْأَبْصَارَ فَقَالَ الْحَسَنُ (یَا أَمِیرَ الْمُؤْمِنِینَ إِنَّ سُلَیْمَانَ بْنَ دَاوُدَ کَانَ مُطَاعاً بِخَاتَمِهِ وَ أَمِیرُ الْمُؤْمِنِینَ بِمَا ذَا یُطَاعُ فَقَالَ (أَنَا عَیْنُ اللَّهِ فِی أَرْضِهِ أَنَا لِسَانُ اللَّهِ النَّاطِقُ فِی خَلْقِهِ أَنَا نُورُ اللَّهِ الَّذِی لَا یُطْفَأُ أَنَا بَابُ اللَّهِ الَّذِی یُؤْتَی مِنْهُ وَ حُجَّتُهُ عَلَی عِبَادِهِ ثُمَّ قَالَ أَ تُحِبُّونَ أَنْ أُرِیَکُمْ خَاتَمَ سُلَیْمَانَ بْنِ دَاوُدَ قُلْنَا نَعَمْ فَأَدْخَلَ یَدَهُ إِلَی جَیْبِهِ فَأَخْرَجَ خَاتَماً مِنْ ذَهَبٍ فَصُّهُ مِنْ یَاقُوتَةٍ حَمْرَاءَ عَلَیْهِ مَکْتُوبٌ مُحَمَّدٌ وَ عَلِیٌّ قَالَ سَلْمَانُ فَتَعَجَّبْنَا مِنْ ذَلِکَ فَقَالَ مِنْ أَیِّ شَیْءٍ تَعْجَبُونَ وَ مَا الْعَجَبُ مِنْ مِثْلِی أَنَا أُرِیکُمُ الْیَوْمَ مَا لَمْ تَرَوْهُ أَبَداً فَقَالَ الْحَسَنُ (أُرِیدُ تُرِینِی یَأْجُوجَ وَ مَأْجُوجَ وَ السَّدَّ الَّذِی بَیْنَنَا وَ بَیْنَهُمْ فَسَارَتِ الرِّیحُ تَحْتَ السَّحَابَةِ فَسَمِعْنَا لَهَا دَوِیّاً کَدَوِیِّ الرَّعْدِ وَ عَلَتْ فِی الْهَوَاءِ وَ أَمِیرُ الْمُؤْمِنِینَ (یَقْدُمُنَا حَتَّی انْتَهَیْنَا إِلَی جَبَلٍ شَامِخٍ فِی الْعُلُوِّ وَ إِذَا شَجَرَةٌ جَافَّةٌ قَدْ تَسَاقَطَتْ أَوْرَاقُهَا وَ جَفَّتْ أَغْصَانُهَا فَقَالَ الْحَسَنُ مَا بَالُ هَذِهِ الشَّجَرَةِ قَدْ یَبِسَتْ فَقَالَ (سَلْهَا فَإِنَّهَا تُجِیبُکَ فَقَالَ الْحَسَنُ أَیَّتُهَا الشَّجَرَةُ مَا بَالُکِ قَدْ حَدَثَ بِکِ مَا نَرَاهُ مِنَ الْجَفَافِ فَلَمْ تُجِبْهُ فَقَال أَمِیرُ الْمُؤْمِنِینَ (بِحَقِّی عَلَیْکِ إِلَّا مَا أَجَبْتِیهِ قَالَ الرَّاوِی وَ اللَّهِ لَقَدْ سَمِعْتُهَا وَ هِیَ تَقُولُ لَبَّیْکَ لَبَّیْکَ یَا وَصِیَّ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ وَ خَلِیفَتَهُ ثُمَّ قَالَتْ یَا أَبَا مُحَمَّدٍ إِنَّ أَمِیرَ الْمُؤْمِنِینَ (کَانَ یَجِیئُنِی فِی کُلِّ لَیْلَةٍ وَقْتَ السَّحَرِ وَ یُصَلِّی عِنْدِی رَکْعَتَیْنِ وَ یُکْثِرُ مِنَ التَّسْبِیحِ فَإِذَا فَرَغَ مِنْ دُعَائِهِ جَاءَتْهُ غَمَامَةٌ بَیْضَاءُ یُنْفَخُ مِنْهَا رِیحُ الْمِسْکِ وَ عَلَیْهَا کُرْسِیٌّ فَیَجْلِسُ فَتَسِیرُ بِهِ وَ کُنْتُ أَعِیشُ بِبَرَکَتِهِ فَانْقَطَعَ عَنِّی مُنْذُ أَرْبَعِینَ یَوْماً فَهَذَا سَبَبُ مَا تَرَاهُ مِنِّی فَقَامَ أَمِیرُ الْمُؤْمِنِینَ (وَ صَلَّی رَکْعَتَیْنِ وَ مَسَحَ بِکَفِّهِ عَلَیْهَا فَاخْضَرَّتْ وَ عَادَتْ إِلَی حَالِهَا وَ أَمَرَ الرِّیحَ فَسَارَتْ بِنَا وَ إِذَا نَحْنُ بِمَلَکٍ یَدُهُ فِی الْمَغْرِبِ وَ الْأُخْرَی بِالْمَشْرِقِ فَلَمَّا نَظَرَ الْمَلَکُ إِلَی أَمِیرِ الْمُؤْمِنِینَ (قَالَ أَشْهَدُ أَنْ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لَا شَرِیکَ لَهُ وَ أَشْهَدُ أَنَّ مُحَمَّداً عَبْدُهُ وَ رَسُولُهُ أَرْسَلَهُ بِالْهُدی وَ دِینِ الْحَقِّ لِیُظْهِرَهُ عَلَی الدِّینِ کُلِّهِ وَ لَوْ کَرِهَ الْمُشْرِکُونَ وَ أَشْهَدُ أَنَّکَ وَصِیُّهُ وَ خَلِیفَتُهُ حَقّاً وَ صِدْقاً فَقُلْنَا یَا أَمِیرَ الْمُؤْمِنِینَ مَنْ هَذَا الَّذِی یَدُهُ فِی الْمَغْرِبِ وَ الْأُخْرَی بِالْمَشْرِق فَقَالَ (هَذَا الْمَلَکُ الَّذِی وَکَّلَهُ اللَّهُ عَزَّ وَ جَلَّ بِظُلْمَةِ اللَّیْلِ وَ النَّهَارِ لَا یَزُولُ إِلَی یَوْمِ الْقِیَامَةِ وَ إِنَّ اللَّهَ عَزَّ وَ جَلَّ جَعَلَ أَمْرَ الدُّنْیَا إِلَیَّ وَ إِنَّ أَعْمَالَ الْخَلْقِ تُعْرَضُ فِی کُلِّ یَوْمٍ عَلَیَّ ثُمَّ تُرْفَعُ إِلَی اللَّهِ عَزَّ وَ جَلَّ ثُمَّ سِرْنَا حَتَّی وَقَفْنَا عَلَی سَدِّ یَأْجُوجَ وَ مَأْجُوجَ فَقَالَ أَمِیرُ الْمُؤْمِنِینَ (لِلرِّیحِ اهْبِطِی بِنَا مِمَّا یَلِی هَذَا الْجَبَلَ وَ أَشَارَ بِیَدِهِ إِلَی جَبَلٍ شَامِخٍ فِی الْعُلُوِّ وَ هُوَ جَبَلُ الخِضْر (فَنَظَرْنَا إِلَی السَّدِّ وَ إِذَا ارْتِفَاعُهُ مَدُّ الْبَصَرِ وَ هُوَ أَسْوَد کَقِطْعَةِ لَیْلٍ دَامِسٍ یَخْرُجُ مِنْ أَرْجَائِهِ الدُّخَانُ فَقَالَ أَمِیرُ الْمُؤْمِنِینَ (یَا أَبَا مُحَمَّدٍ أَنَا صَاحِبُ هَذَا الْأَمْرِ عَلَی هَؤُلَاءِ الْعَبِیدِ قَالَ سَلْمَانُ فَرَأَیْتُ أَصْنَافاً ثَلَاثَةً طُولُ أَحَدِهِمْ مِائَةٌ وَ عِشْرُونَ ذِرَاعاً وَ الثَّانِی طُولُ کُلِّ وَاحِدٍ سَبْعُونَ ذِرَاعاً وَ الثَّالِثُ یَفْرُشُ أَحَدَ أُذُنَیْهِ تَحْتَهُ وَ الْأُخْرَی یَلْتَحِفُ بِهِ ثُمَّ إِنَّ أَمِیرَ الْمُؤْمِنِینَ (أَمَرَ الرِّیحَ فَسَارَتْ بِنَا إِلَی جَبَلِ قَافٍ فَانْتَهَیْتُ إِلَیْهِ وَ إِذَا هُوَ مِنْ زُمُرُّدَةٍ خِضْراءَ وَ عَلَیْهَا مَلَکٌ عَلَی صُورَةِ النَّسْرِ فَلَمَّا نَظَرَ إِلَی أَمِیرِ الْمُؤْمِنِینَ (قَالَ الْمَلَکُ السَّلَامُ عَلَیْکَ یَا وَصِیَّ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ وَ خَلِیفَتَهُ أَ تَأْذَنُ لِی فِی الْکَلَامِ فَرَدَّ عَلَیْهِ السَّلَامَ وَ قَالَ لَهُ إِنْ شِئْتَ تَکَلَّمْ وَ إِنْ شِئْتَ أَخْبَرْتُکَ عَمَّا تَسْأَلُنِی عَنْهُ فَقَالَ الْمَلَکُ بَلْ تَقُولُ أَنْتَ یَا أَمِیرَ الْمُؤْمِنِینَ قَالَ تُرِیدُ أَنْ آذَنَ لَکَ أَنْ تَزُورَ الخِضْر (قَالَ نَعَمْ فَقَالَ (قَدْ أَذِنْتُ لَکَ فَأَسْرَعَ الْمَلَکُ بَعْدَ أَنْ قَالَ بِسْمِ اللَّهِ الرَّحْمنِ الرَّحِیمِ ثُمَّ تَمَشَّیْنَا عَلَی الْجَبَلِ هُنَیْئَةً فَإِذَا بِالْمَلَکِ قَدْ عَادَ إِلَی مَکَانِهِ بَعْدَ زِیَارَةِ الخِضْر (فَقَالَ سَلْمَانُ یَا أَمِیرَ الْمُؤْمِنِینَ رَأَیْتُ الْمَلَکَ مَا زَارَ الخِضْر إِلَّا حِینَ أَخَذَ إِذْنَکَ فَقَالَ (وَ الَّذِی رَفَعَ السَّمَاءَ بِغَیْرِ عَمَدٍ لَوْ أَنَّ أَحَدَهُمْ رَامَ أَنْ یَزُولَ مِنْ مَکَانِهِ بِقَدْرِ نَفَسٍ وَاحِدٍ لَمَا زَالَ حَتَّی آذَنَ لَهُ وَ کَذَلِکَ یَصِیرُ حَالُ وَلَدِیَ الْحَسَنِ وَ بَعْدَه الْحُسَیْنُ وَ تِسْعَةٌ مِنْ وُلْدِ الْحُسَیْنِ تَاسِعُهُمْ قَائِمُهُمْ فَقُلْنَا مَا اسْمُ الْمَلَکِ الْمُوَکَّلِ بِقَافٍ فَقَالَ (تَرْجَائِیلُ فَقُلْنَا یَا أَمِیرَ الْمُؤْمِنِینَ کَیْفَ تَأْتِی کُلَّ لَیْلَةٍ إِلَی هَذَا الْمَوْضِعِ وَ تَعُودُ فَقَالَ کَمَا أَتَیْتُ بِکُمْ وَ الَّذِی فَلَقَ الْحَبَّةَ وَ بَرَأَ النَّسَمَةَ إِنِّی لَأَمْلِکُ مِنْ مَلَکُوتِ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَ الْأَرْضِ مَا لَوْ عَلِمْتُمْ بِبَعْضِهِ لَمَا احْتَمَلَهُ جَنَانُکُمْ إِنَّ اسْمَ اللَّهِ الْأَعْظَمَ عَلَی اثْنَیْنِ وَ سَبْعِینَ حَرْفاً وَ کَانَ عِنْدَ آصَفَ بْنِ بَرْخِیَا حَرْفٌ وَاحِدٌ فَتَکَلَّمَ بِهِ فَخَسَفَ اللَّهُ عَزَّ وَ جَلَّ الْأَرْضَ مَا بَیْنَهُ وَ بَیْنَ عَرْشِ بِلْقِیسَ حَتَّی تَنَاوَلَ السَّرِیرَ ثُمَّ عَادَتِ الْأَرْضُ کَمَا کَانَتْ أَسْرَعَ مِنْ طَرْفِ النَّظَرِ وَ عِنْدَنَا نَحْنُ وَ اللَّهِ اثْنَانِ وَ سَبْعُونَ حَرْفاً وَ حَرْفٌ وَاحِدٌ عِنْدَ اللَّهِ عَزَّ وَ جَلَّ اسْتَأْثَرَ بِهِ فِی عِلْمِ الْغَیْبِ وَ لَا حَوْلَ وَ لَا قُوَّةَ إِلَّا بِاللَّهِ الْعَلِیِّ الْعَظِیمِ عَرَفَنَا مَنْ عَرَفَنَا وَ أَنْکَرَنَا مَنْ أَنْکَرَنَا ثُمَّ قَامَ (وَ قُمْنَا فَإِذَا نَحْنُ بِشَابٍّ فِی الْجَبَلِ یُصَلِّی بَیْنَ قَبْرَیْنِ فَقُلْنَا یَا أَمِیرَ الْمُؤْمِنِینَ مَنْ هَذَا الشَّابُّ فَقَالَ (صَالِحٌ النَّبِیُّ فَقَالَ (وَ هَذَانِ الْقَبْرَانِ لِأُمِّهِ وَ أَبِیهِ وَ إِنَّهُ یَعْبُدُ اللَّهَ بَیْنَهُمَا فَلَمَّا نَظَرَ إِلَیْهِ صَالِحٌ لَمْ یَتَمَالَکْ نَفْسَهُ حَتَّی بَکَی وَ أَوْمَأَ بِیَدِهِ إِلَی أَمِیرِ الْمُؤْمِنِینَ (ثُمَّ أَعَادَهَا إِلَی صَدْرِهِ وَ هُوَ یَبْکِی فَوَقَفَ أَمِیرُ الْمُؤْمِنِینَ (عِنْدَهُ حَتَّی فَرَغَ مِنْ صَلَاتِهِ فَقُلْنَا لَهُ مَا بُکَاؤُکَ قَالَ صَالِحٌ إِنَّ أَمِیرَ الْمُؤْمِنِینَ (کَانَ یَمُرُّ بِی عِنْدَ کُلِّ غَدَاةٍ فَیَجْلِسُ فَتَزْدَادُ عِبَادَتِی بِنَظَرِی إِلَیْهِ فَقُطِعَ ذَلِکَ مُذْ عَشَرَةِ أَیَّامٍ فَأَقْلَقَنِی ذَلِکَ فَتَعَجَّبْنَا مِنْ ذَلِکَ فَقَالَ (تُرِیدُونَ أَنْ أُرِیَکُمْ سُلَیْمَانَ بْنَ دَاوُدَ قُلْنَا نَعَمْ فَقَامَ وَ نَحْنُ مَعَهُ حَتَّی دَخَلَ بُسْتَاناً مَا رَأَیْنَا أَحْسَنَ مِنْهُ وَ فِیهِ مِنْ جَمِیعِ الْفَوَاکِهِ وَ الْأَعْنَابِ وَ أَنْهَارُه تَجْرِی وَ الْأَطْیَارُ یَتَجَاوَبْنَ عَلَی الْأَشْجَارِ فَحِینَ رَأَتْهُ الْأَطْیَارُ أَتَتْ تُرَفْرِفُ حَوْلَهُ حَتَّی تَوَسَّطْنَا الْبُسْتَانَ وَ إِذَا سَرِیرٌ عَلَیْهِ شَابٌّ مُلْقًی عَلَی ظَهْرِهِ وَاضِعٌ یَدَهُ عَلَی صَدْرِهِ فَأَخْرَجَ أَمِیرُ الْمُؤْمِنِینَ (الْخَاتَمَ مِنْ جَیْبِهِ وَ جَعَلَهُ فِی إِصْبَعِ سُلَیْمَانَ بْنِ دَاوُدَ فَنَهَضَ قَائِماً وَ قَالَ السَّلَامُ عَلَیْکَ یَا أَمِیرَ الْمُؤْمِنِینَ وَ وَصِیَّ رَسُولِ رَبِّ الْعَالَمِینَ أَنْتَ وَ اللَّهِ الصِّدِّیقُ الْأَکْبَرُ وَ الْفَارُوقُ الْأَعْظَمُ قَدْ أَفْلَحَ مَنْ تَمَسَّکَ بِکَ وَ قَدْ خَابَ وَ خَسِرَ مَنْ تَخَلَّفَ عَنْکَ وَ إِنِّی سَأَلْتُ اللَّهَ عَزَّ وَ جَلَّ بِکُمْ أَهْلَ الْبَیْتِ فَأُعْطِیتُ ذَلِکَ الْمُلْکَ قَالَ سَلْمَانُ فَلَمَّا سَمِعْنَا کَلَامَ سُلَیْمَانَ بْنِ دَاوُدَ لَمْ أَتَمَالَکْ نَفْسِی حَتَّی وَقَعْتُ عَلَی أَقْدَامِ أَمِیرِ الْمُؤْمِنِینَ (أُقَبِّلُهَا وَ حَمِدْتُ اللَّهَ عَزَّ وَ جَلَّ عَلَی جَزِیلِ عَطَائِهِ بِهِدَایَتِهِ إِلَی وَلَایَةِ أَهْلِ الْبَیْتِ الَّذِینَ أَذْهَبَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُمُ الرِّجْسَ وَ طَهَّرَهُمْ تَطْهِیراً وَ فَعَلَ أَصْحَابِی کَمَا فَعَلْتُ ثُمَّ سَأَلْتُ أَمِیرَ الْمُؤْمِنِینَ مَا وَرَاءَ قَافٍ قَالَ (وَرَاءَهُ مَا لَا یَصِلُ إِلَیْکُمْ عِلْمُهُ فَقُلْنَا تَعْلَمُ ذَلِکَ یَا أَمِیرَ الْمُؤْمِنِینَ فَقَالَ (عِلْمِی بِمَا وَرَاءَهُ کَعِلْمِی بِحَالِ هَذِهِ الدُّنْیَا وَ مَا فِیهَا وَ إِنِّی الْحَفِیظُ الشَّهِیدُ عَلَیْهَا بَعْدَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ (وَ کَذَلِکَ الْأَوْصِیَاءُ مِنْ وُلْدِی بَعْدِی ثُمَّ قَالَ (إِنِّی لَأَعْرَفُ بِطُرُقِ السَّمَاوَاتِ مِنْ طُرُقِ الْأَرْضِ نَحْنُ الِاسْمُ الْمَخْزُونُ الْمَکْنُونُ نَحْنُ الْأَسْمَاءُ الْحُسْنَی الَّتِی إِذَا سُئِلَ اللَّهُ عَزَّ وَ جَلَّ بِهَا أَجَابَ نَحْنُ الْأَسْمَاءُ الْمَکْتُوبَةُ عَلَی الْعَرْشِ وَ لِأَجْلِنَا خَلَقَ اللَّهُ عَزَّ وَ جَلَّ السَّمَاءَ وَ الْأَرْضَ وَ الْعَرْشَ وَ الْکُرْسِیَّ وَ الْجَنَّةَ وَ النَّارَ وَ مِنَّا تَعَلَّمَتِ الْمَلَائِکَةُ التَّسْبِیحَ وَ التَّقْدِیسَ وَ التَّوْحِید وَ التَّهْلِیلَ وَ التَّکْبِیرَ وَ نَحْنُ الْکَلِمَاتُ الَّتِی تَلَقَّاهَا آدَمُ مِنْ رَبِّهِ فَتابَ عَلَیْهِ ثُمَّ قَالَ أَ تُرِیدُونَ أَنْ أُرِیَکُمْ عَجَباً قُلْنَا نَعَمْ قَالَ غُضُّوا أَعْیُنَکُمْ فَفَعَلْنَا ثُمَّ قَالَ افْتَحُوهَا فَفَتَحْنَاهَا فَإِذَا نَحْنُ بِمَدِینَةٍ مَا رَأَیْنَا أَکْبَرَ مِنْهَا الْأَسْوَاقُ فِیهَا قَائِمَةٌ وَ فِیهَا أُنَاسٌ مَا رَأَیْنَا أَعْظَمَ مِنْ خَلْقِهِمْ عَلَی طُولِ النَّخْلِ قُلْنَا یَا أَمِیرَ الْمُؤْمِنِینَ مَنْ هَؤُلَاءِ قَالَ بَقِیَّةُ قَوْمِ عَادٍ کُفَّارٌ لَا یُؤْمِنُونَ بِاللَّهِ عَزَّ وَ جَلَّ أَحْبَبْتُ أَنْ أُرِیَکُمْ إِیَّاهُمْ وَ هَذِهِ الْمَدِینَةَ وَ أَهْلَهَا أُرِیدُ أَنْ أُهْلِکَهُمْ وَ هُمْ لَا یَشْعُرُونَ قُلْنَا یَا أَمِیرَ الْمُؤْمِنِینَ تُهْلِکُهُمْ بِغَیْرِ حُجَّةٍ قَالَ لَا بَلْ بِحُجَّةٍ عَلَیْهِمْ فَدَنَا مِنْهُمْ وَ تَرَاءَی لَهُمْ فَهَمُّوا أَنْ یَقْتُلُوهُ وَ نَحْنُ نَرَاهُمْ وَ هُمْ یَرَوْنَ ثُمَّ تَبَاعَدَ عَنْهُمْ وَ دَنَا مِنَّا وَ مَسَحَ بِیَدِهِ عَلَی صُدُورِنَا وَ أَبْدَانِنَا وَ تَکَلَّمَ بِکَلِمَاتٍ لَمْ نَفْهَمْهَا وَ عَادَ إِلَیْهِمْ ثَانِیَةً حَتَّی صَارَ بِإِزَائِهِمْ وَ صَعِقَ فِیهِمْ صَعْقَة قَالَ سَلْمَانُ لَقَدْ ظَنَنَّا أَنَّ الْأَرْضَ قَدِ انْقَلَبَتْ وَ السَّمَاءَ قَدْ سَقَطَتْ وَ أَنَّ الصَّوَاعِقَ مِنْ فِیهِ قَدْ خَرَجَتْ فَلَمْ یَبْقَ مِنْهُمْ فِی تِلْکَ السَّاعَةِ أَحَدٌ قُلْنَا یَا أَمِیرَ الْمُؤْمِنِینَ مَا صَنَعَ اللَّهُ بِهِمْ قَالَ هَلَکُوا وَ صَارُوا کُلُّهُمْ إِلَی النَّارِ قُلْنَا هَذَا مُعْجِزٌ مَا رَأَیْنَا وَ لَا سَمِعْنَا بِمِثْلِهِ فَقَالَ (أَ تُرِیدُونَ أَنْ أُرِیَکُمْ أَعْجَبَ مِنْ ذَلِکَ فَقُلْنَا لَا نُطِیقُ بِأَسْرِنَا عَلَی احْتِمَالِ شَیْءٍ آخَرَ فَعَلَی مَنْ لَا یَتَوَالاکَ وَ {لَا} یُؤْمِنُ بِفَضْلِکَ وَ عَظِیمِ قَدْرِکَ عَلَی اللَّه عَزَّ وَ جَلَّ لَعْنَةُ اللَّهِ وَ لَعْنَةُ اللَّاعِنِینَ وَ الْمَلَائِکَةِ وَ الْخَلْقِ أَجْمَعِینَ إِلَی یَوْمِ الدِّینِ ثُمَّ سَأَلْنَا الرُّجُوعَ إِلَی أَوْطَانِنَا فَقَالَ أَفْعَلُ ذَلِکَ إِنْ شَاءَ اللَّهُ فَأَشَارَ إِلَی السَّحَابَتَیْنِ فَدَنَتَا مِنَّا فَقَالَ (خُذُوا مَوَاضِعَکُمْ فَجَلَسْنَا عَلَی سَحَابَةٍ وَ جَلَسَ (عَلَی الْأُخْرَی وَ أَمَرَ الرِّیحَ فَحَمَلَتْنَا حَتَّی صِرْنَا فِی الْجَوِّ وَ رَأَیْنَا الْأَرْضَ کَالدِّرْهَمِ ثُمَّ حَطَّتْنَا فِی دَارِ أَمِیرِ الْمُؤْمِنِینَ (فِی أَقَلَّ مِنْ طَرْفِ النَّظَرِ وَ کَانَ وُصُولُنَا إِلَی الْمَدِینَةِ وَقْتَ الظُّهْرِ وَ الْمُؤَذِّنُ یُؤَذِّنُ وَ کَانَ خُرُوجُنَا مِنْهَا وَقْتَ عَلَتِ الشَّمْسُ فَقُلْنَا بِاللَّهِ الْعَجَبُ کُنَّا فِی جَبَلِ قَافٍ مَسِیرَةَ خَمْسِ سِنِینَ وَ عُدْنَا فِی خَمْسِ سَاعَاتٍ مِنَ النَّهَارِ فَقَالَ أَمِیرُ الْمُؤْمِنِینَ (لَوْ أَنَّنِی أَرَدْتُ أَنْ أَجُوبَ الدُّنْیَا بِأَسْرِهَا وَ السَّمَاوَاتِ السَّبْعَ وَ أَرْجِعَ فِی أَقَلَّ مِنَ الطَّرْفِ لَفَعَلْتُ بِمَا عِنْدِی مِنِ اسْمِ اللَّهِ الْأَعْظَمِ فَقُلْنَا یَا أَمِیرَ الْمُؤْمِنِینَ أَنْتَ وَ اللَّهِ الْآیَةُ الْعُظْمَی وَ الْمُعْجِزُ الْبَاهِرُ بَعْدَ أَخِیکَ وَ ابْنِ عَمِّکَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ (.
94.en: Salman al-Farsi said: I was with al-Hasan, al-Husayn, Muhammad ibn al-Hanafiyyah, Muhammad ibn Abi Bakr, Ammar ibn Yasir, and al-Miqdad ibn al-Aswad al-Kindi (may Allah be pleased with them all) in the presence of the Commander of the Faithful. His son al-Hasan said to him, "O Commander of the Faithful, Solomon son of David asked his Lord for a kingdom that would not be suitable for anyone after him, and He granted it to him. Do you possess anything of what Solomon son of David possessed?" He replied, "By the One who split the seed and created the soul, Solomon son of David asked Allah, the Almighty and Majestic, for the kingdom and He gave it to him. Indeed, your father possesses what no one before him possessed after your grandfather, the Messenger of Allah, and no one will possess it after him." Al-Hasan said, "We wish for you to show us some of the honor with which Allah, the Almighty and Majestic, has favored you." He said, "I will do so, if Allah wills." The Commander of the Faithful stood up, performed ablution, prayed two rak'ahs, and supplicated to Allah, the Almighty and Majestic, with words we did not understand. Then he gestured with his hand toward the west, and no sooner had he done so than a cloud appeared and hovered over the house, and beside it appeared another cloud. The Commander of the Faithful said, "O cloud, descend by the permission of Allah, the Almighty and Majestic." It descended, saying, "I bear witness that there is no god but Allah, that Muhammad is the Messenger of Allah, and that you are his successor and executor. Whoever doubts you has perished, and whoever holds fast to you has taken the path of salvation." Then the cloud spread out upon the ground as if it were a laid-out carpet. The Commander of the Faithful said, "Sit upon the cloud," so we sat and took our places. He gestured to the other cloud, and it descended, saying the same as the first. The Commander of the Faithful sat upon it alone. Then he spoke some words and gestured for it to move toward the west. Suddenly, the wind entered beneath the two clouds and lifted them gently. I looked toward the Commander of the Faithful and saw him upon a throne, with light radiating from his face, almost blinding the eyes. Al-Hasan said, "O Commander of the Faithful, Solomon son of David was obeyed through his ring; through what is the Commander of the Faithful obeyed?" He replied, "I am the eye of Allah in His land, I am the speaking tongue of Allah among His creation, I am the light of Allah that is not extinguished, I am the door of Allah through which He is approached, and I am His proof over His servants." Then he said, "Do you wish for me to show you the ring of Solomon son of David?" We said, "Yes." He reached into his pocket and brought out a gold ring with a red ruby setting, upon which was written 'Muhammad and Ali'. Salman said, "We were amazed by that." He said, "Why are you amazed? What is amazing about someone like me? Today I will show you what you have never seen." Al-Hasan said, "I wish for you to show me Gog and Magog and the barrier that is between us and them." The wind moved beneath the cloud, and we heard a sound like the roar of thunder as it rose into the air, with the Commander of the Faithful leading us, until we reached a towering mountain. There was a withered tree, its leaves fallen and its branches dried. Al-Hasan asked, "What is the matter with this tree that it has dried up?" He said, "Ask it, for it will answer you." Al-Hasan said, "O tree, what has happened to you that we see you in this state of dryness?" It did not answer him. The Commander of the Faithful said, "By my right over you, answer him." The narrator said, "By Allah, I heard it saying, 'At your service, at your service, O executor of the Messenger of Allah and his successor.' Then it said, 'O Abu Muhammad, the Commander of the Faithful used to come to me every night at the time of dawn, pray two rak'ahs beside me, and engage in much glorification. When he finished his supplication, a white cloud would come to him, from which the scent of musk was blown, and upon it was a throne; he would sit upon it and it would travel with him. I lived by his blessing, but he has been absent from me for forty days, and this is the reason for what you see of me.'" The Commander of the Faithful stood, prayed two rak'ahs, and wiped his palm over it, whereupon it turned green and returned to its former state. He commanded the wind, and it traveled with us until we encountered an angel whose one hand was in the west and the other in the east. When the angel looked at the Commander of the Faithful, he said, "I bear witness that there is no god but Allah, alone with no partner, and I bear witness that Muhammad is His servant and messenger, whom He sent with guidance and the religion of truth to manifest it over all religion, even if the polytheists dislike it. And I bear witness that you are his successor and his true and honest vicegerent." We said, "O Commander of the Faithful, who is this whose hand is in the west and the other in the east?" He said, "This is the angel whom Allah, the Almighty and Majestic, has appointed over the darkness of the night and the day; he will not cease until the Day of Resurrection. Indeed, Allah, the Almighty and Majestic, has entrusted the affairs of the world to me, and the deeds of the creation are presented to me every day, then they are raised to Allah, the Almighty and Majestic." Then we traveled until we stood at the barrier of Gog and Magog. The Commander of the Faithful said to the wind, "Descend with us to the side of this mountain," and he gestured with his hand to a towering mountain, which was the mountain of al-Khidr. We looked at the barrier, and its height reached as far as the eye could see; it was black like a piece of pitch-dark night, with smoke emerging from its edges. The Commander of the Faithful said, "O Abu Muhammad, I am the master of this affair over these slaves." Salman said, "I saw three types: the height of one type was one hundred and twenty cubits; the second type, each one was seventy cubits; and the third type would spread one of its ears beneath itself and cover itself with the other." Then the Commander of the Faithful commanded the wind, and it traveled with us to Mount Qaf. I reached it, and it was made of green emerald, and upon it was an angel in the form of an eagle. When he looked at the Commander of the Faithful, the angel said, "Peace be upon you, O executor of the Messenger of Allah and his successor. Do you permit me to speak?" He returned the greeting and said, "If you wish, speak, or if you wish, I will inform you of what you are asking me about." The angel said, "Rather, you speak, O Commander of the Faithful." He said, "Do you wish for me to permit you to visit al-Khidr?" He said, "Yes." He said, "I have permitted you." The angel hurried after saying, "In the name of Allah, the Most Gracious, the Most Merciful." We walked on the mountain for a while, and the angel returned to his place after visiting al-Khidr. Salman said, "O Commander of the Faithful, I saw that the angel did not visit al-Khidr until he took your permission." He said, "By the One who raised the sky without pillars, if one of them intended to move from his place by the measure of a single breath, he would not move until I permitted him. Such will be the state of my son al-Hasan, and after him al-Husayn, and nine from the descendants of al-Husayn, the ninth of whom is their Qaim." We asked, "What is the name of the angel appointed over Qaf?" He said, "Tarja'il." We said, "O Commander of the Faithful, how do you come to this place every night and return?" He said, "Just as I brought you. By the One who split the seed and created the soul, I possess of the kingdom of the heavens and the earth that which, if you knew some of it, your hearts could not bear. The Greatest Name of Allah consists of seventy-two letters; Asaf ibn Barkhiya had one letter, and he spoke it, and Allah, the Almighty and Majestic, caused the earth to sink between him and the throne of Bilqis until he took the throne, then the earth returned as it was faster than the blink of an eye. We, by Allah, possess seventy-two letters, and one letter is with Allah, the Almighty and Majestic, which He has kept to Himself in the knowledge of the unseen. There is no power and no strength except by Allah, the Most High, the Almighty. Those who know us have known us, and those who deny us have denied us." Then he stood, and we stood, and we found a young man on the mountain praying between two graves. We said, "O Commander of the Faithful, who is this young man?" He said, "Salih the Prophet, and these two graves are for his mother and father, and he worships Allah between them." When Salih looked at him, he could not restrain himself and wept, gesturing with his hand toward the Commander of the Faithful, then returning it to his chest while weeping. The Commander of the Faithful stood by him until he finished his prayer. We asked him, "What is your weeping?" Salih said, "The Commander of the Faithful used to pass by me every morning and sit, and my worship would increase by looking at him. But this has been cut off for ten days, and that has troubled me." We were amazed by that. He said, "Do you wish for me to show you Solomon son of David?" We said, "Yes." He stood, and we were with him until he entered a garden the likes of which we had never seen, containing all kinds of fruits and grapes, with rivers flowing and birds answering one another on the trees. When the birds saw him, they came fluttering around him until we reached the middle of the garden, where there was a throne with a young man lying on his back, placing his hand on his chest. The Commander of the Faithful took the ring from his pocket and placed it on the finger of Solomon son of David. He stood up and said, "Peace be upon you, O Commander of the Faithful and executor of the Messenger of the Lord of the Worlds. You, by Allah, are the Greatest Truthful One and the Greatest Distinguisher. He who holds fast to you has succeeded, and he who lags behind you has failed and lost. I asked Allah, the Almighty and Majestic, by you, the People of the House, and I was granted that kingdom." Salman said, "When we heard the words of Solomon son of David, I could not restrain myself until I fell at the feet of the Commander of the Faithful, kissing them, and I praised Allah, the Almighty and Majestic, for His abundant gift in guiding me to the guardianship of the People of the House, from whom Allah has removed impurity and purified them with a thorough purification. My companions did as I did. Then I asked the Commander of the Faithful, 'What is beyond Qaf?' He said, 'Beyond it is that which your knowledge cannot reach.' We said, 'Do you know that, O Commander of the Faithful?' He said, 'My knowledge of what is beyond it is like my knowledge of the state of this world and what is in it. I am the Guardian and Witness over it after the Messenger of Allah, and so are the successors from my descendants after me.' Then he said, 'I am more knowledgeable of the paths of the heavens than the paths of the earth. We are the stored, hidden Name; we are the Most Beautiful Names which, when Allah, the Almighty and Majestic, is asked by them, He answers. We are the Names written upon the Throne, and for our sake Allah, the Almighty and Majestic, created the heaven, the earth, the Throne, the Footstool, Paradise, and Hell. From us the angels learned glorification, sanctification, declaration of oneness, declaration of greatness, and declaration of majesty. We are the words that Adam received from his Lord, so He accepted his repentance.' Then he said, 'Do you wish for me to show you something amazing?' We said, 'Yes.' He said, 'Close your eyes.' We did so. Then he said, 'Open them.' We opened them, and we were in a city the likes of which we had never seen larger, with markets established and people whose stature we had never seen greater, reaching the height of a palm tree. We said, 'O Commander of the Faithful, who are these?' He said, 'They are the remnants of the people of 'Ad, disbelievers who do not believe in Allah, the Almighty and Majestic. I wanted to show them to you, and this city and its people; I intend to destroy them while they are unaware.' We said, 'O Commander of the Faithful, will you destroy them without a proof?' He said, 'No, but with a proof against them.' He approached them and appeared to them, and they intended to kill him, while we saw them and they saw us. Then he moved away from them and approached us, wiped his hand over our chests and bodies, and spoke words we did not understand. He returned to them a second time until he was face to face with them, and he let out a cry against them. Salman said, 'We thought the earth had overturned and the sky had fallen, and that thunderbolts had emerged from his mouth. Not one of them remained at that hour.' We said, 'O Commander of the Faithful, what did Allah do with them?' He said, 'They perished and all became of the Fire.' We said, 'This is a miracle the likes of which we have neither seen nor heard.' He said, 'Do you wish for me to show you something more amazing than that?' We said, 'We cannot bear to witness anything else. So upon him who does not take you as his guardian and does not believe in your excellence and your great status before Allah, the Almighty and Majestic, be the curse of Allah, the curse of the cursers, the angels, and all of creation until the Day of Judgment.' Then we asked to return to our homes, and he said, 'I will do that, if Allah wills.' He gestured to the two clouds, and they drew near us. He said, 'Take your places.' We sat upon a cloud, and he sat upon the other. He commanded the wind, and it carried us until we were in the atmosphere and saw the earth like a dirham. Then it set us down in the house of the Commander of the Faithful in less than the blink of an eye. Our arrival in Medina was at the time of Dhuhr, and the muezzin was calling the adhan, while our departure from it was when the sun had risen. I said, 'By Allah, how amazing! We were at Mount Qaf, a journey of five years, and we returned in five hours of the day.' The Commander of the Faithful said, 'If I had wanted to traverse the entire world and the seven heavens and return in less than a blink, I would have done so by what I possess of the Greatest Name of Allah.' We said, 'O Commander of the Faithful, you, by Allah, are the Great Sign and the manifest miracle after your brother and cousin, the Messenger of Allah.'"

94.ar: امیرالمؤمنین (- عَنْ سَلْمَانَ الْفَارِسِیِّ قَالَ: کُنَّا مَعَ مَوْلَانَا أَمِیرِ الْمُؤْمِنِینَ (فَقُلْتُ: یَا أَمِیرَ الْمُؤْمِنِینَ (أُحِبُّ أَنْ أَرَی مِنْ مُعْجِزَاتِکَ شَیْئاً. قَالَ: یَا سَلْمَانُ مَا تُرِیدُ؟ قُلْتُ: أُرِیدُ أَنْ تُرِیَنِی نَاقَةَ ثَمُودَ وَ شَیْئاً مِنْ مُعْجِزَاتِکَ. فَقَالَ: أَفْعَلُ إِنْ شَاءَ اللَّهُ تَعَالَی ثُمَّ قَامَ وَ دَخَلَ مَنْزِلَهُ وَ خَرَجَ وَ تَحْتَهُ حِصَانٌ أَدْهَمُ وَ عَلَیْهِ قَبَاءٌ أَبْیَضُ وَ قَلَنْسُوَةٌ بَیْضَاءُ. ثُمَّ نَادَی: یَا قَنْبَرُ أَخْرِجْ إِلَیَّ ذَلِکَ الْفَرَسَ فَأَخْرَجَ إِلَیْهِ حِصَاناً أَدْهَمَ أَنمَرَ، فَقَالَ: ارْکَبْ یَا أَبَا عَبْدِ اللَّهِ. قَالَ سَلْمَان: فَرَکِبْتُهُ فَإِذَا لَهُ جَنَاحَانِ مُلْتَصِقَانِ إِلَی جَنْبِهِ، قَالَ: فَصَاحَ بِهِ الْإِمَامُ (فَتَعَلَّقَ فِی الْهَوَاءِ وَ کُنْتُ أَسْمَعُ وَ اللَّهِ خَفْقَ أَجْنِحَةِ الْمَلَائِکَةِ (وَ تَسْبِیحَهَا تَحْتَ الْعَرْشِ ثُمَّ حَضَرْنَا عَلَی سَاحِلِ الْبَحْرِ وَ إِذَا هُوَ بَحْرٌ عُجَاجٌ مُغْطَمِطٌ بِالْأَمْوَاجِ فَنَظَرَ إِلَیْهِ الْإِمَامُ (شَزْراً فَسَکَنَ الْبَحْرُ مِنْ غَلَیَانِهِ فَقُلْتُ لَهُ: یَا مَوْلَایَ سَکَنَ الْبَحْرُ مِنْ نَظَرِکَ إِلَیْه؟ فَقَالَ: خَشِیَ أَنْ آمُرَ فِیهِ بِأَمْرٍ. ثُمَّ قَبَضَ عَلَی یَدِی وَ سَارَ عَلَی وَجْهِ الْمَاءِ وَ الْخَیْلُ تَتْبَعُنَا لَا یَقُودُهَا أَحَدٌ فَوَ اللَّهِ مَا ابْتَلَّتْ أَقْدَامُنَا وَ لَا حَوَافِرُ الْخَیْلِ. قَالَ سَلْمَانُ: فعبرنا ذَلِکَ الْبَحْرِ فَدُفِعْنَا إِلَی جَزِیرَةٍ کَثِیرَةِ الْأَشْجَارِ وَ الْأَثْمَارِ وَ الْأَطْیَارِ وَ الْأَنْهَارِ وَ إِذَا بِشَجَرَةٍ عَظِیمَةٍ بِلَا صَدْعٍ وَ لَا زَهْرٍ فَهَزَّهَا صَلَوَاتُ اللَّهِ عَلَیْهِ بِقَضِیبٍ کَانَ فِی یَدِهِ فَانْشَقَّتْ وَ خَرَجَ مِنْهَا نَاقَةٌ طُولُهَا ثَمَانُونَ ذِرَاعاً وَ عَرْضُهَا أَرْبَعُونَ ذِرَاعاً وَ خَلْفَهَا قَلُوصٌ. فَقَالَ لِی: ادْنُ مِنْهَا وَ اشْرَبْ مِنْ لَبَنِهَا حَتَّی تَرْوَی فَدَنَوْتُ مِنْهَا وَ شَرِبْتُ حَتَّی رَوِیتُ وَ کَانَ لَبَنُهَا أَعْذَبَ مِنَ الشَّهْدِ وَ أَلْیَنَ مِنَ الزَّبَدِ فَقَالَ لِی: یَا سَلْمَانُ هَذَا حَسَنٌ؟ فَقُلْتُ: یَا مَوْلَایَ وَ مَا أَحْسَنُ مِنْهَا؟ فَقَالَ: تُرِیدُ أَنْ أُرِیَکَ مَا هُوَ أَحْسَنُ مِنْهَا؟ فَقُلْتُ: نَعَمْ یَا أَمِیرَ الْمُؤْمِنِینَ (فَنَادَی (اخْرُجِی یَا حَسْنَاءُ فَخَرَجَتْ إِلَیْنَا نَاقَةٌ طُولُهَا مِائَةُ ذِرَاعٍ وَ عِشْرُونَ ذِرَاعاً وَ عَرْضُهَا سِتُّونَ ذِرَاعاً وَ رَأْسُهَا مِنَ الْیَاقُوتِ الْأَحْمَرِ وَ صَدْرُهَا مِنَ الْعَنْبَرِ الْأَشْهَبِ وَ قَوَائِمُهَا مِنَ الزَّبَرْجَدِ الْأَخْضَرِ وَ زِمَامُهَا مِنَ الْیَاقُوتِ الْأَخْضَرِ وَ جَنْبُهَا الْأَیْمَنُ مِنَ الذَّهَبِ وَ جَنْبُهَا الْأَیْسَرُ مِنَ الْفِضَّةِ وَ عَرْضُهَا مِنَ اللُّؤْلُؤِ الرَّطْبِ فَقَالَ لِی: یَا سَلْمَانُ اشْرَبْ مِنْ لَبَنِهَا قَالَ سَلْمَانُ: فَالْتَقَمْتُ الضَّرْعَ فَإِذَا هِیَ تَحْلُبُ عَسَلًا صَافِیاً مَحْضاً. فَقُلْتُ: یَا سَیِّدِی هَذِهِ لِمَنْ؟ قَالَ: هذِهِ لَکَ یَا سَلْمَانُ وَ لِسَائِرِ الْمُؤْمِنِینَ مِنْ أَوْلِیَائِی. ثُمَّ قَالَ (: ارْجِعِی إِلَی الشَّجَرَةِ فَرَجَعَتْ مِنَ الْوَقْتِ وَ سَاقَنِی إِلَی تِلْکَ الْجَزِیرَةِ حَتَّی وَرَدَ بِی إِلَی شَجَرَةٍ وَ فِی أَصْلِهَا مَائِدَةٌ عَظِیمَةٌ فِیهَا طَعَامٌ تَفُوحُ مِنْهَا رَائِحَةُ الْمِسْکِ وَ إِذَا بِطَائِرٍ فِی صُورَةِ النَّسْرِ الْعَظِیمِ قَالَ سَلْمَانُ: فَوَثَبَ ذَلِکَ الطَّیْرُ فَسَلَّمَ عَلَیْهِ (وَ رَجَعَ إِلَی مَوْضِعِهِ. فَقُلْتُ: یَا أَمِیرَ الْمُؤْمِنِینَ (مَا هَذِهِ الْمَائِدَةُ؟ فَقَالَ: هَذِهِ مَنْصُوبَةٌ فِی هَذَا الْمَوْضِعِ لِشِیعَتِنَا. فَقُلْتُ: مَا هَذَا الطَّائِرُ؟ قَالَ: مَلَکٌ مُوَکَّلٌ بِهَا إِلَی یَوْمِ الْقِیَامَةِ. فَقُلْتُ: وَحْدَهُ یَا سَیِّدِی؟ فَقَالَ: یَجْتَازُ بِهِ الخِضْر (کُلَّ یَوْمٍ مَرَّةً ثُمَّ قَبَضَ بِیَدِی ثُمَّ سَارَ إِلَی بَحْرٍ آخَرَ فَعَبَرْنَا إِذَا بِجَزِیرَةٍ عَظِیمَةٍ فِیهَا قَصْرٌ لَبِنَةٌ مِنْ ذَهَبٍ وَ لَبِنَةٌ مِنْ فِضَّةٍ وَ شُرَفُهَا مِنْ عَقِیقٍ أَصْفَرَ وَ عَلَی کُلِّ رُکْنٍ مِنَ الْقَصْرِ سَبْعُونَ صَفّاً مِنَ الْمَلَائِکَةِ (فَسَلَّمُوا عَلَیْهِ ثُمَّ أَذِنَ لَهُمْ فَرَجَعُوا إِلَی أَمَاکِنَهُمْ. قَالَ سَلْمَانُ: ثُمَّ دَخَلَ أَمِیرُ الْمُؤْمِنِینَ (إِلَی الْقَصْرِ وَ إِذَا فِیهِ أَشْجَارٌ وَ أَثْمَارٌ وَ أَنْهَارٌ وَ أَطْیَارٌ وَ أَلْوَانُ النَّبَاتِ فَجَعَلَ أَمِیرُ الْمُؤْمِنِینَ (یَمْشِی فِیهِ حَتَّی وَصَلَ إِلَی آخِرِهِ فَوَقَفَ (عَلَی بِرْکَةٍ فِی الْبُسْتَانِ ثُمَّ صَعِدَ عَلَی سَطْحِهِ وَ إِذَا بِکُرْسِیٍّ مِنَ الذَّهَبِ الْأَحْمَرِ فَجَلَسَ عَلَیْهِ وَ أَشْرَفْنَا عَلَی الْقَصْرِ وَ إِذَا بِبَحْرٍ أَسْوَدَ یُغَطْمِطُ أَمْوَاجُهُ کَالْجِبَالِ الرَّاسِیَاتِ فَنَظَرَ إِلَیْهِ شَزْراً فَسَکَنَ مِنْ غَلَیَانِهِ حَتَّی کَأَنَّهُ الْمُذْنِبُ. فَقُلْتُ: سَکَنَ الْبَحْرُ مِنْ غَلَیَانِهِ لَمَّا نَظَرْتَ إِلَیْهِ؟ فَقَالَ: خَشِیَ أَنْ آمُرَ فِیهِ بِأَمْرٍ، أَ تَدْرِی یَا سَلْمَانُ أَیُّ بَحْرٍ هَذَا؟ فَقُلْتُ: لَا یَا سَیِّدِی. فَقَالَ هَذَا الْبَحْرُ الَّذِی غَرِقَ فِیهِ فِرْعَوْنُ وَ مَلَؤُهُ الْمُذْنِبَةُ حُمِلَتْ عَلَی جَنَاحِ جَبْرَئِیلَ (ثُمَّ زَخَّ بِهَا فِی الْهَوَاءِ فَهَوَتْ إِلَی قَرَارِهُ إِلَی یَوْمِ الْقِیَامَةِ. فَقُلْتُ: یَا أَمِیرَ الْمُؤْمِنِینَ (هَلْ سِرْنَا فَرْسَخَیْنِ؟ فَقَالَ: یَا سَلْمَانُ لَقَدْ سِرْتَ خَمْسِینَ أَلْفَ فَرْسَخٍ وَ دُرْتَ حَوْلَ الدُّنْیَا عِشْرِینَ أَلْفَ مَرَّةٍ. فَقُلْتُ: یَا سَیِّدِی، وَ کَیْفَ هَذَا؟ قالَ: یَا سَلْمَانُ إِذَا کَانَ ذُو الْقَرْنَیْنِ طَافَ شَرْقَهَا وَ غَرْبَهَا وَ بَلَغَ إِلَی سَدِّ یَأْجُوجَ وَ مَأْجُوجَ فَأَنَّی یَتَعَذَّرُ عَلَیَّ وَ أَنَا أَمِیرُ الْمُؤْمِنِینَ وَ خَلِیفَةُ رَبِّ الْعَالَمِینَ؟ یَا سَلْمَانُ أَ مَا قَرَأْتَ قَوْلَهُ تَعَالَی عالِمُ الْغَیْبِ فَلا یُظْهِرُ عَلی غَیْبِهِ أَحَداً إِلَّا مَنِ ارْتَضی مِنْ رَسُولٍ؟ فَقُلْتُ: بَلَی یَا أَمِیرَ الْمُؤْمِنِینَ (فَقَالَ: یَا سَلْمَانُ أَنَا الْمُرْتَضَی مِنَ الرَّسُولِ الَّذِی أَظْهَرَهُ اللَّهُ عَزَّ وَجَلَّ عَلی غَیْبِهِ أَنَا الْعَالِمُ الرَّبَّانِیُّ أَنَا الَّذِی هَوَّنَ اللَّهُ عَلَیَّ الشَّدَائِدَ فَطَوَی لَهُ الْبَعِیدَ. قَالَ سَلْمَانُ: فَسَمِعْتُ صَائِحاً یَصِیحُ فِی السَّمَاءِ أَسْمَعُ الصَّوْتَ وَ لَا أَرَی الشَّخْصَ وَ هُوَ یَقُولُ: صَدَقْتَ صَدَقْتَ أَنْتَ الصَّادِقُ الصِّدِّیقُ صَلَوَاتُ اللَّهِ عَلَیْکَ. ثُمَّ وَثَبَ قَائِماً وَ رَکِبَ فَرَسَهُ وَ رَکِبْتُ مَعَهُ وَ صَاحَ بِهِمَا فَطَارَا فِی الْهَوَاءِ وَ إِذَا نَحْنُ عَلَی بَابِ الْکُوفَةِ. هَذَا کُلُّهُ وَ قَدْ مَضَی مِنَ اللَّیْلِ ثَلَاثُ سَاعَاتٍ فَقَالَ لِی: یَا سَلْمَانُ الْوَیْلُ ثُمَّ الْوَیْلُ لِمَنْ لَا یَعْرِفُنَا حَقَّ مَعْرِفَتِنَا وَ أَنْکَرَ وَلَایَتَنَا یَا سَلْمَانُ أَیُّهُمَا أَفْضَلُ مُحَمَّدٌ (أَمْ سُلَیْمَانُ بْنُ دَاوُدَ (؟ فَقُلْتُ: بَلْ مُحَمَّدٌ (أَفْضَلُ. قَالَ: یَا سَلْمَانُ آصَفُ بْنُ بَرْخِیَا قَدَرَ أَنْ یَحْمِلَ عَرْشَ بِلْقِیسَ إِلَی سُلَیْمَانَ (فِی طَرْفَةِ عَیْنٍ وَ عِنْدَهُ عِلْمٌ مِنَ الْکِتابِ، فَکَیْفَ لَا أَفْعَلُ أَنَا ذَلِکَ وَ عِنْدِی أَلْفُ کِتَابٍ وَ أَرْبَعَةٌ وَ عِشْرُونَ أَلْفَ کِتَابٍ أَنْزَلَ اللَّهُ تَعَالَی عَلَی شَیْثِ بْنِ آدَمَ (خَمْسِینَ صَحِیفَةً وَ عَلَی إِدْرِیسَ (ثَلَاثِینَ وَ عَلَی إِبْرَاهِیمَ الْخَلِیلِ (عِشْرِینَ وَ التَّوْرَاةَ وَ الْإِنْجِیلَ وَ الزَّبُورَ وَ الْفُرْقَانَ الْعَظِیمَ؟ فَقُلْتُ: صَدَقْتَ یَا أَمِیرَ الْمُؤْمِنِینَ (هَکَذَا یَکُونَ الْإِمَامُ. فَقَالَ: اعْلَمْ یَا سَلْمَانُ الشَّاکُّ فِی أُمُورِنَا وَ عُلُومِنَا کَالْمُمْتَرِی فِی مَعْرِفَتِنَا وَ حُقُوقِنَا قَدْ فَرَضَ اللَّهُ عَزَّوَجَلَّ فِی کِتَابِهِ فِی غَیْرِ مَوْضِعٍ وَ بَیَّنَ فِیهِ مَا وَجَبَ الْعِلْمُ بِهِ وَ هُوَ غَیْرُ مَکْنُونٍ.
94.en: Salman al-Farsi said: We were in the presence of our master, the Commander of the Faithful (peace be upon him), and I said: "O Commander of the Faithful, I would love to see some of your miracles." He said: "O Salman, what do you desire?" I said: "I desire that you show me the she-camel of Thamud and some of your miracles." He said: "I shall do so, if Allah the Almighty wills." Then he stood up, entered his house, and emerged riding a dark-colored horse, wearing a white qaba (tunic) and a white cap. He then called out: "O Qanbar, bring me that horse." Qanbar brought him a dark, spotted horse, and he said: "Mount, O Abu Abd Allah." Salman said: I mounted it, and it had two wings attached to its sides. The Imam shouted at it, and it ascended into the air. By Allah, I could hear the flapping of the angels' wings and their glorification (tasbih) beneath the Throne. Then we arrived at the seashore, and it was a turbulent sea, surging with waves. The Imam looked at it sternly, and the sea ceased its boiling. I said to him: "O my master, did the sea calm down because of your looking at it?" He replied: "It feared that I might issue a command regarding it." Then he took my hand and walked upon the surface of the water, and the horses followed us, with no one leading them. By Allah, neither our feet nor the horses' hooves became wet. Salman said: We crossed that sea and were brought to an island filled with trees, fruits, birds, and rivers. There was a great tree without any cracks or flowers. He (peace be upon him) shook it with a rod he held in his hand; it split open, and a she-camel emerged from it, eighty cubits long and forty cubits wide, with a young camel behind her. He said to me: "Approach her and drink of her milk until you are satisfied." I approached her and drank until I was satisfied; her milk was sweeter than honey and softer than foam. He said to me: "O Salman, is this good?" I said: "O my master, what could be better than this?" He said: "Do you wish for me to show you what is better than it?" I said: "Yes, O Commander of the Faithful." He called out: "Come forth, O Hasna!" A she-camel emerged to us, one hundred and twenty cubits long and sixty cubits wide. Her head was of red ruby, her chest of grey ambergris, her legs of green chrysolite, her bridle of green ruby, her right side of gold, her left side of silver, and her width of moist pearl. He said to me: "O Salman, drink of her milk." Salman said: I took the udder in my mouth, and she yielded pure, clear honey. I said: "O my master, for whom is this?" He said: "This is for you, O Salman, and for the rest of the believers among my followers (awliya)." Then he said: "Return to the tree," and she returned immediately. He led me through that island until he brought me to a tree at the base of which was a great table spread with food, from which the scent of musk wafted. There was a bird in the form of a great eagle. Salman said: That bird leaped up, greeted him, and returned to its place. I said: "O Commander of the Faithful, what is this table?" He said: "This is set in this place for our Shi'a." I said: "What is this bird?" He said: "An angel appointed over it until the Day of Resurrection." I said: "Alone, O my master?" He said: "Al-Khidr (peace be upon him) passes by it once every day." Then he took my hand and traveled to another sea. We crossed it and found a great island containing a palace with bricks of gold and bricks of silver, its battlements of yellow carnelian, and on every corner of the palace were seventy rows of angels who greeted him, then he gave them permission, and they returned to their places.
